"""Pure library report builders and decoupled-evidence diagnostics."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from evalforge_maestro._canonical import canonical_json_str, redact_secrets, scrub_secret_text
from evalforge_maestro.types import (
    CalibrationGateSummary,
    CalibrationReport,
    DecoupledEvidenceDiagnostic,
    DriftWarning,
    EvidenceDecouplingCategory,
    MetricStatus,
    QualityGateResult,
    ReportDiagnosticsSummary,
    ReportDocument,
    ReportKind,
    RunComparisonReport,
    RunRecord,
    TrendReport,
)

_RETRIEVAL_METRIC_IDS = frozenset(
    {
        "precision_at_k",
        "recall_at_k",
        "mrr",
        "ndcg_at_k",
        "hit_rate_at_k",
        "context_relevance",
    }
)
_ANSWER_SURFACE_METRIC_IDS = frozenset(
    {
        "exact_match",
        "normalized_match",
        "json_schema_validation",
        "answer_correctness",
        "answer_relevance",
    }
)
_ANSWER_OR_GROUNDING_METRIC_IDS = _ANSWER_SURFACE_METRIC_IDS | frozenset({"groundedness"})


def _scrub_json_tree(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return scrub_secret_text(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return {str(k): _scrub_json_tree(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [_scrub_json_tree(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return [_scrub_json_tree(item) for item in value]
    return value


def _deduplicate_drift(warnings: list[DriftWarning]) -> list[DriftWarning]:
    seen: set[tuple[str, str | None, str | None, str | None, str]] = set()
    unique: list[DriftWarning] = []
    for item in warnings:
        sig = (
            item.category.value,
            item.metric_id,
            item.baseline_run_id,
            item.candidate_run_id,
            item.explanation,
        )
        if sig not in seen:
            seen.add(sig)
            unique.append(item)
    return unique


def detect_decoupled_evidence(run: RunRecord) -> list[DecoupledEvidenceDiagnostic]:
    """Identify cases where retrieval evidence quality diverges from final answer or grounding."""
    diagnostics: list[DecoupledEvidenceDiagnostic] = []
    for case in run.case_results:
        retrieval_pass = [
            m_id
            for m_id, res in case.metrics.items()
            if m_id in _RETRIEVAL_METRIC_IDS and res.status == MetricStatus.PASS
        ]
        retrieval_or_grounding_fail = [
            m_id
            for m_id, res in case.metrics.items()
            if (m_id in _RETRIEVAL_METRIC_IDS or m_id == "groundedness")
            and res.status == MetricStatus.FAIL
        ]
        answer_pass = [
            m_id
            for m_id, res in case.metrics.items()
            if m_id in _ANSWER_SURFACE_METRIC_IDS and res.status == MetricStatus.PASS
        ]
        answer_or_grounding_fail = [
            m_id
            for m_id, res in case.metrics.items()
            if m_id in _ANSWER_OR_GROUNDING_METRIC_IDS and res.status == MetricStatus.FAIL
        ]
        retrieval_fail = [
            m_id
            for m_id, res in case.metrics.items()
            if m_id in _RETRIEVAL_METRIC_IDS and res.status == MetricStatus.FAIL
        ]
        chunk_ids = [chunk.id for chunk in case.execution.retrieved_chunks]

        if answer_pass and retrieval_or_grounding_fail:
            diagnostics.append(
                DecoupledEvidenceDiagnostic(
                    case_id=case.case_id,
                    mandatory=case.mandatory,
                    category=EvidenceDecouplingCategory.ANSWER_PASSED_RETRIEVAL_FAILED,
                    passed_metrics=sorted(answer_pass),
                    failed_metrics=sorted(retrieval_or_grounding_fail),
                    retrieved_chunk_ids=chunk_ids,
                    explanation=(
                        f"Case {case.case_id!r} passed answer metrics ({', '.join(sorted(answer_pass))}) "
                        f"while retrieval/grounding failed ({', '.join(sorted(retrieval_or_grounding_fail))})."
                    ),
                )
            )
        elif retrieval_pass and not retrieval_fail and answer_or_grounding_fail:
            diagnostics.append(
                DecoupledEvidenceDiagnostic(
                    case_id=case.case_id,
                    mandatory=case.mandatory,
                    category=EvidenceDecouplingCategory.RETRIEVAL_PASSED_ANSWER_FAILED,
                    passed_metrics=sorted(retrieval_pass),
                    failed_metrics=sorted(answer_or_grounding_fail),
                    retrieved_chunk_ids=chunk_ids,
                    explanation=(
                        f"Case {case.case_id!r} retrieved relevant context ({', '.join(sorted(retrieval_pass))}) "
                        f"while answer/grounding failed ({', '.join(sorted(answer_or_grounding_fail))})."
                    ),
                )
            )
    return diagnostics


def build_run_report(
    run: RunRecord,
    *,
    comparison: RunComparisonReport | None = None,
    trend: TrendReport | None = None,
    gate: QualityGateResult | None = None,
    title: str | None = None,
) -> ReportDocument:
    """Build a three-way-separated, secret-scrubbed ReportDocument for an evaluation RunRecord."""
    anomalies = (
        list(gate.anomalies)
        if gate is not None
        else (list(comparison.anomalies) if comparison is not None else [])
    )
    drift_pool: list[DriftWarning] = []
    if gate is not None:
        drift_pool.extend(gate.drift_warnings)
    if comparison is not None:
        drift_pool.extend(comparison.drift_warnings)
    if trend is not None:
        drift_pool.extend(trend.drift_warnings)

    diagnostics = ReportDiagnosticsSummary(
        mandatory_failed_case_ids=list(run.mandatory_failed_case_ids),
        decoupled_evidence_cases=detect_decoupled_evidence(run),
        anomaly_highlights=anomalies,
        drift_highlights=_deduplicate_drift(drift_pool),
    )
    resolved_title = title or f"Evaluation Report: {run.dataset_id} ({run.run_id})"
    return ReportDocument(
        report_kind=ReportKind.RUN,
        title=resolved_title,
        generated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        evaluation=run,
        comparison=comparison,
        trend=trend,
        gate=gate,
        diagnostics=diagnostics,
    )


def build_comparison_report(
    comparison: RunComparisonReport,
    *,
    candidate_run: RunRecord | None = None,
    gate: QualityGateResult | None = None,
    title: str | None = None,
) -> ReportDocument:
    """Build a secret-scrubbed pairwise comparison ReportDocument."""
    anomalies = list(gate.anomalies) if gate is not None else list(comparison.anomalies)
    drift_pool = list(gate.drift_warnings) if gate is not None else list(comparison.drift_warnings)
    mandatory_failed = list(candidate_run.mandatory_failed_case_ids) if candidate_run else []
    decoupled = detect_decoupled_evidence(candidate_run) if candidate_run else []

    diagnostics = ReportDiagnosticsSummary(
        mandatory_failed_case_ids=mandatory_failed,
        decoupled_evidence_cases=decoupled,
        anomaly_highlights=anomalies,
        drift_highlights=_deduplicate_drift(drift_pool),
    )
    resolved_title = (
        title
        or f"Comparison Report: {comparison.candidate_run_id} vs {comparison.baseline_run_id}"
    )
    return ReportDocument(
        report_kind=ReportKind.COMPARE,
        title=resolved_title,
        generated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        evaluation=candidate_run,
        comparison=comparison,
        gate=gate,
        diagnostics=diagnostics,
    )


def build_trend_report(
    trend: TrendReport,
    *,
    gate: QualityGateResult | None = None,
    title: str | None = None,
) -> ReportDocument:
    """Build a secret-scrubbed sliding-window trend ReportDocument."""
    anomalies = list(gate.anomalies) if gate is not None else []
    drift_pool = list(gate.drift_warnings) if gate is not None else list(trend.drift_warnings)
    diagnostics = ReportDiagnosticsSummary(
        anomaly_highlights=anomalies,
        drift_highlights=_deduplicate_drift(drift_pool),
    )
    resolved_title = title or f"Trend Report (window={trend.window})"
    return ReportDocument(
        report_kind=ReportKind.TREND,
        title=resolved_title,
        generated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        trend=trend,
        gate=gate,
        diagnostics=diagnostics,
    )


def build_calibration_report(
    calibration: CalibrationReport,
    *,
    min_agreement: float | None = None,
    strict: bool = False,
    title: str | None = None,
) -> ReportDocument:
    """Build a secret-scrubbed judge calibration ReportDocument with optional threshold gate."""
    observed = calibration.exact_agreement_rate
    if calibration.valid_cases == 0:
        passed = not (strict or min_agreement is not None)
        reason = (
            "Calibration yielded 0 valid human-judge pairs; inconclusive."
            if not passed
            else "Calibration yielded 0 valid pairs in diagnostic mode (--strict disabled)."
        )
    elif min_agreement is not None and (observed is None or observed < min_agreement - 1e-9):
        passed = False
        reason = (
            f"Observed exact agreement {observed}% is below configured minimum "
            f"{min_agreement}%."
        )
    elif strict and calibration.inconclusive_cases > 0:
        passed = False
        reason = (
            f"Calibration encountered {calibration.inconclusive_cases} inconclusive sample(s) "
            "under --strict mode."
        )
    else:
        passed = True
        reason = (
            f"Calibration passed with {observed}% exact agreement "
            f"(min_agreement={min_agreement}%)."
            if min_agreement is not None
            else f"Diagnostic calibration completed ({observed}% exact agreement)."
        )

    cal_gate = CalibrationGateSummary(
        min_agreement=min_agreement,
        observed_agreement=observed,
        strict=strict,
        valid_cases=calibration.valid_cases,
        inconclusive_cases=calibration.inconclusive_cases,
        passed=passed,
        reason=reason,
    )
    resolved_title = title or f"Judge Calibration Report: {calibration.metric_id}"
    return ReportDocument(
        report_kind=ReportKind.CALIBRATE,
        title=resolved_title,
        generated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        calibration=calibration,
        calibration_gate=cal_gate,
    )


def render_report_json(document: ReportDocument, *, pretty: bool = False) -> str:
    """Serialize a secret-redacted, schema-validated ReportDocument to canonical JSON."""
    payload = redact_secrets(document.model_dump(mode="json"))
    scrubbed = _scrub_json_tree(payload)
    return canonical_json_str(scrubbed, pretty=pretty)

"""Three-way Markdown report renderer separating Evaluation, Regression, and Quality Gate."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from evalforge_maestro._canonical import redact_secrets, scrub_secret_text
from evalforge_maestro.types import (
    CalibrationReport,
    MetricStatus,
    QualityGateResult,
    ReportDocument,
    RunComparisonReport,
    RunRecord,
    TrendReport,
)


def _cell(value: Any, *, max_len: int | None = None) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "-"
    text = scrub_secret_text(str(value))
    text = text.replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " ").replace("|", "\\|").strip()
    if max_len is not None and len(text) > max_len:
        text = text[: max_len - 3] + "..."
    return text or "-"


def _fmt_num(value: float | None, *, suffix: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "-"
    return f"{value:.6g}{suffix}"


def _render_evaluation_section(
    evaluation: RunRecord | None,
    calibration: CalibrationReport | None,
) -> list[str]:
    lines = ["## Evaluation", ""]
    if evaluation is not None:
        lines.extend(
            [
                f"- **Run ID**: `{_cell(evaluation.run_id)}`",
                f"- **Timestamp (UTC)**: `{evaluation.timestamp.isoformat()}`",
                f"- **Dataset**: `{_cell(evaluation.dataset_id)}` "
                f"(version=`{_cell(evaluation.dataset_version)}`, "
                f"fingerprint=`{evaluation.dataset_fingerprint[:12]}...`, "
                f"cases=`{evaluation.evaluated_case_count}`, capped=`{evaluation.dataset_capped}`)",
                f"- **Target**: system=`{_cell(evaluation.system_version)}`, "
                f"model=`{_cell(evaluation.model_id)}`, "
                f"config_fp=`{_cell(evaluation.config_fingerprint[:12] + '...' if evaluation.config_fingerprint else None)}`, "
                f"judge_fp=`{_cell(evaluation.judge_config_fingerprint[:12] + '...' if evaluation.judge_config_fingerprint else None)}`",
                "",
                "| Metric | Version | Mean | Min | Max | Pass | Fail | Warn | Inconclusive | N/A |",
                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
            ]
        )
        for metric_id in sorted(evaluation.aggregates):
            agg = evaluation.aggregates[metric_id]
            lines.append(
                "| "
                + " | ".join(
                    [
                        f"`{_cell(metric_id)}`",
                        f"`{_cell(agg.metric_version)}`",
                        _fmt_num(agg.mean_score),
                        _fmt_num(agg.min_score),
                        _fmt_num(agg.max_score),
                        str(agg.pass_count),
                        str(agg.fail_count),
                        str(agg.warning_count),
                        str(agg.inconclusive_count),
                        str(agg.not_applicable_count),
                    ]
                )
                + " |"
            )
        lines.append("")
    elif calibration is not None:
        sanitized_cfg = redact_secrets(calibration.judge_config.model_dump(mode="json"))
        lines.extend(
            [
                f"- **Metric**: `{_cell(calibration.metric_id)}` (v`{_cell(calibration.metric_version)}`)",
                f"- **Judge Config**: model=`{_cell(sanitized_cfg.get('model'))}`, "
                f"mock_mode=`{calibration.judge_config.mock_mode}`, "
                f"local_only=`{calibration.judge_config.local_only}`, "
                f"fingerprint=`{calibration.judge_config_fingerprint[:12]}...`",
                f"- **Samples**: total=`{calibration.total_cases}`, "
                f"valid=`{calibration.valid_cases}`, inconclusive=`{calibration.inconclusive_cases}`",
                "",
                "| Metric | Value |",
                "| --- | --- |",
                f"| Exact Agreement Rate | {_fmt_num(calibration.exact_agreement_rate, suffix='%')} |",
                f"| Too Generous Rate | {_fmt_num(calibration.too_generous_rate)} |",
                f"| Too Harsh Rate | {_fmt_num(calibration.too_harsh_rate)} |",
                f"| Mean Human Score | {_fmt_num(calibration.mean_human_score)} |",
                f"| Mean Judge Score | {_fmt_num(calibration.mean_judge_score)} |",
                f"| Mean Score Delta | {_fmt_num(calibration.mean_score_delta)} |",
                f"| Recommended Pass Threshold | `{calibration.recommended_pass_threshold:.6g}` |",
                "",
            ]
        )
        if calibration.disagreements:
            lines.extend(
                [
                    "### Calibration Disagreements",
                    "",
                    "| Case ID | Type | Human Score | Judge Score | Status | Delta | Rationale |",
                    "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
                ]
            )
            for item in calibration.disagreements:
                lines.append(
                    "| "
                    + " | ".join(
                        [
                            f"`{_cell(item.case_id)}`",
                            f"`{item.disagreement_type.value}`",
                            _fmt_num(item.human_score),
                            _fmt_num(item.judge_score),
                            f"`{item.judge_status.value}`",
                            _fmt_num(item.score_delta),
                            _cell(item.judge_rationale, max_len=120),
                        ]
                    )
                    + " |"
                )
            lines.append("")
    else:
        lines.extend(["No evaluation run payload attached to this report.", ""])
    return lines


def _render_regression_section(
    comparison: RunComparisonReport | None,
    trend: TrendReport | None,
) -> list[str]:
    lines = ["## Regression", ""]
    if comparison is None and trend is None:
        lines.extend(["No baseline comparison or sliding-window trend analysis configured.", ""])
        return lines

    if comparison is not None:
        lines.extend(
            [
                f"### Pairwise Comparison (`{_cell(comparison.candidate_run_id)}` vs "
                f"`{_cell(comparison.baseline_run_id)}`)",
                "",
                f"- **Baseline Alias**: `{_cell(comparison.baseline_name)}`",
                f"- **Matched Cases**: `{comparison.matched_case_count}` "
                f"(added=`{len(comparison.added_case_ids)}`, removed=`{len(comparison.removed_case_ids)}`, "
                f"regressed=`{len(comparison.regressed_case_ids)}`, "
                f"mandatory_regressed=`{len(comparison.mandatory_regressed_case_ids)}`)",
                "",
                "| Metric | Baseline | Candidate | Delta | Direction |",
                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
            ]
        )
        for metric_id in sorted(comparison.metric_comparisons):
            mc = comparison.metric_comparisons[metric_id]
            lines.append(
                "| "
                + " | ".join(
                    [
                        f"`{_cell(metric_id)}`",
                        _fmt_num(mc.baseline_score),
                        _fmt_num(mc.candidate_score),
                        _fmt_num(mc.delta),
                        f"`{mc.direction.value}`",
                    ]
                )
                + " |"
            )
        lines.append("")

    if trend is not None:
        lines.extend(
            [
                f"### Sliding Window Trend (window=`{trend.window}`, "
                f"inspected=`{len(trend.inspected_run_ids)}` runs)",
                "",
                f"- **Dataset Filter**: `{_cell(trend.dataset_id_filter)}` | "
                f"**Model Filter**: `{_cell(trend.model_id_filter)}`",
                "",
                "| Metric | Valid Points | Slope / Run | Direction | First | Last | Mean |",
                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
            ]
        )
        for metric_id in sorted(trend.metrics):
            ts = trend.metrics[metric_id]
            lines.append(
                "| "
                + " | ".join(
                    [
                        f"`{_cell(metric_id)}`",
                        f"{ts.valid_points}/{ts.window_runs}",
                        _fmt_num(ts.slope),
                        f"`{ts.direction.value}`",
                        _fmt_num(ts.first_score),
                        _fmt_num(ts.last_score),
                        _fmt_num(ts.mean_score),
                    ]
                )
                + " |"
            )
        lines.append("")

    return lines


def _render_gate_section(
    gate: QualityGateResult | None,
    document: ReportDocument,
) -> list[str]:
    lines = ["## Acceptance / Quality Gate", ""]
    if gate is not None:
        lines.extend(
            [
                f"- **Decision**: **`{gate.decision.value}`** (`passed={gate.passed}`, "
                f"`blocking={gate.blocking}`, `inconclusive_rate={gate.inconclusive_rate:.6g}`)",
                f"- **Summary**: {_cell(gate.summary)}",
                "",
            ]
        )
        if gate.checks:
            lines.extend(
                [
                    "| Rule | Status | Metric | Observed | Threshold | Details |",
                    "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
                ]
            )
            for chk in gate.checks:
                lines.append(
                    "| "
                    + " | ".join(
                        [
                            f"`{_cell(chk.rule_id)}`",
                            f"`{chk.status.value}`",
                            f"`{_cell(chk.metric_id)}`",
                            _cell(chk.observed),
                            _cell(chk.threshold),
                            _cell(chk.message, max_len=140),
                        ]
                    )
                    + " |"
                )
            lines.append("")
        return lines

    if document.calibration_gate is not None:
        cg = document.calibration_gate
        verdict = "PASS" if cg.passed else "FAIL"
        lines.extend(
            [
                f"- **Calibration Gate Decision**: **`{verdict}`** (`strict={cg.strict}`, "
                f"`min_agreement={_fmt_num(cg.min_agreement, suffix='%')}`, "
                f"`observed={_fmt_num(cg.observed_agreement, suffix='%')}`)",
                f"- **Reason**: {_cell(cg.reason)}",
                "",
            ]
        )
        return lines

    lines.extend(["No quality gate policy evaluated for this report.", ""])
    return lines


def _render_diagnostics_section(document: ReportDocument) -> list[str]:
    diag = document.diagnostics
    lines = ["## Diagnostics & Anomalies", ""]
    has_findings = bool(
        diag.mandatory_failed_case_ids
        or diag.decoupled_evidence_cases
        or diag.anomaly_highlights
        or diag.drift_highlights
    )

    if diag.mandatory_failed_case_ids:
        joined = ", ".join(f"`{_cell(cid)}`" for cid in diag.mandatory_failed_case_ids)
        lines.append(f"- **Mandatory Failed Cases**: {joined}")

    if diag.decoupled_evidence_cases:
        lines.extend(
            [
                "",
                "### Evidence Decoupling Findings",
                "",
                "| Case ID | Mandatory | Category | Passed | Failed | Chunks | Explanation |",
                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
            ]
        )
        for item in diag.decoupled_evidence_cases:
            lines.append(
                "| "
                + " | ".join(
                    [
                        f"`{_cell(item.case_id)}`",
                        str(item.mandatory),
                        f"`{item.category.value}`",
                        _cell(", ".join(item.passed_metrics)),
                        _cell(", ".join(item.failed_metrics)),
                        _cell(", ".join(item.retrieved_chunk_ids)),
                        _cell(item.explanation, max_len=140),
                    ]
                )
                + " |"
            )

    if diag.anomaly_highlights:
        lines.extend(
            [
                "",
                "### Anti-Masking & Disagreement Anomalies",
                "",
                "| Type | Severity | Scope | Case ID | Metric ID | Explanation |",
                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
            ]
        )
        for flag in diag.anomaly_highlights:
            lines.append(
                "| "
                + " | ".join(
                    [
                        f"`{flag.anomaly_type.value}`",
                        f"`{flag.severity.value}`",
                        f"`{flag.scope.value}`",
                        f"`{_cell(flag.case_id)}`",
                        f"`{_cell(flag.metric_id)}`",
                        _cell(flag.explanation, max_len=140),
                    ]
                )
                + " |"
            )

    if diag.drift_highlights:
        lines.extend(
            [
                "",
                "### Cross-Version Provenance Drift Warnings",
                "",
                "| Category | Metric ID | Baseline | Candidate | Explanation |",
                "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
            ]
        )
        for dw in diag.drift_highlights:
            lines.append(
                "| "
                + " | ".join(
                    [
                        f"`{dw.category.value}`",
                        f"`{_cell(dw.metric_id)}`",
                        _cell(dw.baseline_value, max_len=40),
                        _cell(dw.candidate_value, max_len=40),
                        _cell(dw.explanation, max_len=140),
                    ]
                )
                + " |"
            )

    if document.evaluation is not None:
        failing_cases = [
            rec
            for rec in document.evaluation.case_results
            if rec.execution.errors
            or any(
                m.status in {MetricStatus.FAIL, MetricStatus.INCONCLUSIVE}
                for m in rec.metrics.values()
            )
        ]
        if failing_cases:
            has_findings = True
            lines.extend(
                [
                    "",
                    "### Failed / Errored Case Highlights",
                    "",
                    "| Case ID | Mandatory | Failed/Inconclusive Metrics | Errors | Output Preview |",
                    "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
                ]
            )
            for rec in failing_cases[:25]:
                bad_metrics = [
                    f"{mid}={m.status.value}"
                    for mid, m in sorted(rec.metrics.items())
                    if m.status in {MetricStatus.FAIL, MetricStatus.INCONCLUSIVE}
                ]
                lines.append(
                    "| "
                    + " | ".join(
                        [
                            f"`{_cell(rec.case_id)}`",
                            str(rec.mandatory),
                            _cell(", ".join(bad_metrics)),
                            _cell("; ".join(rec.execution.errors), max_len=100),
                            _cell(rec.execution.output, max_len=100),
                        ]
                    )
                    + " |"
                )

    if not has_findings:
        lines.extend(["Zero mandatory failures, anomalies, decoupling issues, or drift warnings.", ""])
    else:
        lines.append("")
    return lines


def render_markdown(document: ReportDocument) -> str:
    """Render deterministic, secret-scrubbed Markdown with Three-Way Concern Separation."""
    header = [
        f"# {_cell(document.title)}",
        "",
        f"- **Schema Version**: `{document.schema_version}` | "
        f"**Kind**: `{document.report_kind.value}` | "
        f"**Generated (UTC)**: `{document.generated_at.isoformat()}`",
        "",
    ]
    sections = [
        *header,
        *_render_evaluation_section(document.evaluation, document.calibration),
        *_render_regression_section(document.comparison, document.trend),
        *_render_gate_section(document.gate, document),
        *_render_diagnostics_section(document),
    ]
    return "\n".join(sections).rstrip() + "\n"

"""Unit tests for PII detection and pre-network egress blocking."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from evalforge_maestro._canonical import detect_pii_categories
from evalforge_maestro.exceptions import LocalOnlyPolicyError
from evalforge_maestro.judges.metrics import GroundednessMetric
from evalforge_maestro.judges.security import (
    is_remote_judge_endpoint,
    validate_pii_egress,
    wrap_pii_guarded_metric,
)
from evalforge_maestro.types import (
    EvaluationCase,
    ExecutionResult,
    JudgeConfig,
    RetrievedChunk,
)


def test_detect_pii_categories_covers_email_phone_ssn_card_and_secrets() -> None:
    payload = {
        "email": "Contact alice.smith@example.org for details.",
        "phone": "Call +1-555-234-5678 or (415) 555-0199.",
        "ssn": "TIN/SSN is 123-45-6789.",
        "card": "Visa 4111-1111-1111-1111 charged.",
        "auth": "Authorization: Bearer super_secret_token_999",
    }
    cats = detect_pii_categories(payload)
    assert cats == ["email_address", "payment_card", "phone_number", "secret_token", "us_ssn"]


def test_detect_pii_categories_ignores_non_luhn_ids_and_dates() -> None:
    clean = {
        "date": "2026-11-19",
        "trace_id": "1234567890123456",  # 16 digits failing Luhn (total = 62 mod 10 != 0)
        "all_same": "0000-0000-0000-0000",
        "score": 0.912345,
        "text": "Paris is the capital of France with 99.9% uptime SLA.",
        "api_key": "[REDACTED]",
    }
    assert detect_pii_categories(clean) == []


def test_validate_pii_egress_never_echoes_raw_pii() -> None:
    secret_email = "private.customer@secretcorp.com"
    secret_ssn = "123-45-6789"
    with pytest.raises(LocalOnlyPolicyError) as exc_info:
        validate_pii_egress(
            {"query": f"Reset password for {secret_email} ({secret_ssn})"},
            enabled=True,
            context_label="unit-test",
        )
    msg = str(exc_info.value)
    assert "email_address" in msg
    assert "us_ssn" in msg
    assert secret_email not in msg
    assert secret_ssn not in msg

    # Disabled policy permits text cleanly
    validate_pii_egress(secret_email, enabled=False, context_label="disabled")


def test_wrap_pii_guarded_metric_blocks_remote_before_completion_fn() -> None:
    called = False

    async def _should_not_run(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> str:
        nonlocal called
        called = True
        return '{"score": 1.0, "rationale": "ok"}'

    remote_metric = GroundednessMetric(
        config=JudgeConfig(model="openai/gpt-4o-mini", mock_mode=False, local_only=False),
        completion_fn=_should_not_run,
    )
    assert is_remote_judge_endpoint(remote_metric.judge_config) is True

    guarded = wrap_pii_guarded_metric(remote_metric, block_pii=True)
    case = EvaluationCase(id="pii-1", input="Who owns account?")
    exec_res = ExecutionResult(
        case_id="pii-1",
        input="Who owns account?",
        output="Reach bob@example.org at 555-867-5309.",
        retrieved_chunks=[RetrievedChunk(id="c1", text="Support record")],
        elapsed_seconds=0.01,
    )
    with pytest.raises(LocalOnlyPolicyError):
        guarded.evaluate(case, exec_res)
    assert called is False


def test_wrap_pii_guarded_metric_leaves_mock_and_loopback_unblocked() -> None:
    mock_metric = GroundednessMetric(
        config=JudgeConfig(model="openai/gpt-4o-mini", mock_mode=True, local_only=False)
    )
    assert is_remote_judge_endpoint(mock_metric.judge_config) is False
    assert wrap_pii_guarded_metric(mock_metric, block_pii=True) is mock_metric

    ollama_local = JudgeConfig(model="ollama/llama3.2", mock_mode=False, local_only=False)
    assert is_remote_judge_endpoint(ollama_local) is False

    custom_remote = JudgeConfig(
        model="custom/model",
        api_base="https://judge.internal.example.com",
        mock_mode=False,
        local_only=False,
    )
    assert is_remote_judge_endpoint(custom_remote) is True

"""Unit tests for offline ReplayAdapter loading and validation."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from evalforge_maestro.adapters import ReplayAdapter
from evalforge_maestro.exceptions import AdapterError, DatasetError
from evalforge_maestro.types import (
    CaseEvaluationRecord,
    EvaluationCase,
    ExecutionResult,
    MetricResult,
    MetricStatus,
    RunRecord,
    TargetAdapter,
)


def _exec(case_id: str, output: str = "Paris") -> ExecutionResult:
    return ExecutionResult(
        case_id=case_id,
        input="Capital?",
        output=output,
        elapsed_seconds=0.01,
        system_version="sys-v1",
        model_id="mdl-v1",
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_replay_adapter_from_jsonl_and_target_protocol(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    jsonl_path = tmp_path / "executions.jsonl"
    jsonl_path.write_text(
        "\n".join(
            [
                _exec("c1", "Paris").model_dump_json(),
                _exec("c2", "London").model_dump_json(),
            ]
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    adapter = ReplayAdapter.from_file(jsonl_path)
    assert isinstance(adapter, TargetAdapter)
    assert adapter.case_ids == frozenset({"c1", "c2"})
    assert adapter.system_version == "sys-v1"
    assert adapter.model_id == "mdl-v1"
    assert adapter.config_fingerprint is not None

    res1 = await adapter.execute(EvaluationCase(id="c1", input="q1"))
    assert res1.output == "Paris"

    with pytest.raises(AdapterError, match="missing-id"):
        await adapter.execute(EvaluationCase(id="missing-id", input="q3"))


def test_replay_adapter_supports_json_array_and_run_record(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    arr_path = tmp_path / "arr.json"
    arr_path.write_text(
        json.dumps([_exec("a1", "Alpha").model_dump(mode="json")]),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    arr_adapter = ReplayAdapter.from_file(arr_path)
    assert arr_adapter.case_ids == frozenset({"a1"})

    run_rec = RunRecord(
        run_id="run-replay-src",
        timestamp=datetime(2026, 11, 19, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        package_version="0.1.0",
        dataset_id="ds-1",
        dataset_fingerprint="a" * 64,
        evaluated_case_count=1,
        system_version="sys-r",
        model_id="mdl-r",
        metric_versions={"exact_match": "1.0.0"},
        case_results=[
            CaseEvaluationRecord(
                case_id="r1",
                execution=_exec("r1", "Beta"),
                metrics={
                    "exact_match": MetricResult(
                        metric_id="exact_match",
                        metric_version="1.0.0",
                        score=1.0,
                        status=MetricStatus.PASS,
                        explanation="exact",
                    )
                },
            )
        ],
    )
    run_path = tmp_path / "run.json"
    run_path.write_text(run_rec.model_dump_json(), encoding="utf-8")
    run_adapter = ReplayAdapter.from_file(run_path)
    assert run_adapter.case_ids == frozenset({"r1"})
    assert run_adapter.system_version == "sys-r"
    assert run_adapter.model_id == "mdl-r"


def test_replay_adapter_rejects_duplicates_empty_and_bad_records(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    dup_path = tmp_path / "dup.jsonl"
    dup_path.write_text(
        _exec("c1").model_dump_json() + "\n" + _exec("c1").model_dump_json() + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    with pytest.raises(DatasetError, match="Duplicate case_id"):
        ReplayAdapter.from_file(dup_path)

    empty_path = tmp_path / "empty.jsonl"
    empty_path.write_text("\n\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(DatasetError, match="zero execution records"):
        ReplayAdapter.from_file(empty_path)

    bad_path = tmp_path / "bad.jsonl"
    bad_path.write_text('{"case_id": ""}\n', encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(DatasetError, match="Invalid ExecutionResult"):
        ReplayAdapter.from_file(bad_path)

    with pytest.raises(DatasetError, match="not found"):
        ReplayAdapter.from_file(tmp_path / "absent.jsonl")

"""Pure stdlib CLI argument parser preserving cold-start isolation on --help."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence
from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version
from typing import Any, NoReturn


class CLIUsageError(Exception):
    """Raised internally when CLI arguments fail syntax or constraint parsing."""

    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message


class _StrictArgumentParser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def error(self, message: str) -> NoReturn:
        raise CLIUsageError(message)


def _package_version() -> str:
    try:
        return version("evalforge-maestro")
    except PackageNotFoundError:  # pragma: no cover - source checkout fallback
        return "0.1.0.dev0"


def _add_global_flags(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
    parser.add_argument(
        "--config",
        default=argparse.SUPPRESS,
        help="Explicit path to TOML config file (overrides non-recursive ./evalforge.toml).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--env-file",
        default=argparse.SUPPRESS,
        help="Explicit opt-in .env file loaded strictly below OS environment variables.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--storage-dir",
        default=argparse.SUPPRESS,
        help="Artifact store directory root (default: .evalforge).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--log-level",
        choices=["DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR"],
        default=argparse.SUPPRESS,
        help="Stderr diagnostic verbosity level.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--log-json",
        action="store_true",
        default=argparse.SUPPRESS,
        help="Emit structured JSON log records strictly to stderr.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        default=argparse.SUPPRESS,
        help="Emit solely a single schema-validated JSON payload to stdout.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--quiet",
        "-q",
        action="store_true",
        default=argparse.SUPPRESS,

"""Unit tests for 5-tier CLI configuration precedence and secret masking."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from evalforge_maestro._canonical import REDACTED_VALUE
from evalforge_maestro.cli.config import (
    format_resolved_config_text,
    parse_env_file,
    parse_metric_spec_text,
    resolve_cli_config,
)
from evalforge_maestro.exceptions import ConfigurationError
from evalforge_maestro.types import ConfigSourceTier


def test_five_tier_precedence_and_non_recursive_cwd(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    parent = tmp_path / "workspace"
    subdir = parent / "subproject"
    subdir.mkdir(parents=True)

    # Parent evalforge.toml MUST be ignored under non-recursive CWD discovery
    (parent / "evalforge.toml").write_text(
        '[run]\ndataset = "parent-ignored.jsonl"\nmax_concurrency = 99\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    # CWD evalforge.toml + explicit --env-file + OS env + CLI overrides
    (subdir / "evalforge.toml").write_text(
        '[run]\ndataset = "file-ds.jsonl"\nmax_concurrency = 3\n'
        'baseline = "file-base"\n\n'
        '[metrics]\nenabled = ["exact_match", "precision_at_k"]\n'
        "[metrics.precision_at_k]\nk = 3\n\n"
        "[security]\nblock_pii = true\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    # CWD .env MUST NOT be auto-loaded unless --env-file is explicitly passed
    (subdir / ".env").write_text("EVALFORGE_RUN_ID=implicit-should-ignore\n", encoding="utf-8")

    opt_env = subdir / "custom.env"
    opt_env.write_text(
        "# comment\n"
        "EVALFORGE_DATASET=envfile-ds.jsonl\n"
        "export EVALFORGE_MAX_CONCURRENCY=6\n"
        "EVALFORGE_JUDGE_API_KEY='sk-from-env-file-secret-123'\n"
        "EVALFORGE_STRICT=true # trailing comment\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    os_env = {
        "EVALFORGE_MAX_CONCURRENCY": "8",
        "EVALFORGE_BASELINE": "env-base",
    }
    cli_overrides = {
        "env_file": str(opt_env),
        "baseline": "cli-base",
    }

    resolved, raw_key, warnings = resolve_cli_config(
        cli_overrides=cli_overrides,
        cwd=subdir,
        environ=os_env,
    )
    assert warnings == []
    assert resolved.dataset == "envfile-ds.jsonl"  # env_file > file
    assert resolved.execution.max_concurrency == 8  # env > env_file > file
    assert resolved.baseline == "cli-base"  # cli > env > file
    assert resolved.strict is True
    assert resolved.security.block_pii is True
    assert resolved.run_id is None  # implicit CWD .env was ignored
    assert [m.metric_id for m in resolved.metrics] == ["exact_match", "precision_at_k"]
    assert resolved.metrics[1].params["k"] == 3
    assert raw_key == "sk-from-env-file-secret-123"
    assert resolved.judge.api_key == REDACTED_VALUE

    by_key = {p.key: p for p in resolved.provenance}
    assert by_key["baseline"].source == ConfigSourceTier.CLI
    assert by_key["execution.max_concurrency"].source == ConfigSourceTier.ENV
    assert by_key["dataset"].source == ConfigSourceTier.ENV_FILE
    assert by_key["security.block_pii"].source == ConfigSourceTier.FILE
    assert by_key["storage_dir"].source == ConfigSourceTier.DEFAULT
    assert by_key["judge.api_key"].masked is True
    assert by_key["judge.api_key"].value == REDACTED_VALUE

    rendered = format_resolved_config_text(resolved)
    assert "sk-from-env-file-secret-123" not in rendered
    assert REDACTED_VALUE in rendered
    assert "sk-from-env-file-secret-123" not in json.dumps(resolved.model_dump(mode="json"))

    # Without CWD evalforge.toml in parent, subdir file shouldn't inherit parent values
    isolated = parent / "clean_child"
    isolated.mkdir()
    clean_cfg, _, _ = resolve_cli_config(cwd=isolated, environ={})
    assert clean_cfg.dataset is None
    assert clean_cfg.execution.max_concurrency == 4


def test_toml_hygiene_warning_and_validation_errors(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    secret_toml = tmp_path / "secret.toml"
    secret_toml.write_text(
        '[judge]\nmodel = "gpt-4o"\napi_key = "sk-plain-toml-secret"\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    resolved, raw_key, warnings = resolve_cli_config(config_path=secret_toml, environ={})
    assert raw_key == "sk-plain-toml-secret"
    assert resolved.judge.api_key == REDACTED_VALUE
    assert len(warnings) == 1
    assert "Plaintext judge.api_key" in warnings[0]
    assert "sk-plain-toml-secret" not in warnings[0]

    bad_toml = tmp_path / "bad.toml"
    bad_toml.write_text("[unknown_section]\nx = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError, match="Invalid configuration structure"):
        resolve_cli_config(config_path=bad_toml, environ={})

    syntax_toml = tmp_path / "syntax.toml"
    syntax_toml.write_text("[run\ndataset = 'broken'\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError, match="Invalid TOML syntax"):
        resolve_cli_config(config_path=syntax_toml, environ={})

    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError, match="not found"):
        resolve_cli_config(config_path=tmp_path / "absent.toml", environ={})

    bad_env = tmp_path / "bad.env"
    bad_env.write_text("NOT_A_KEY_VALUE_LINE\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError, match="Malformed line 1"):
        parse_env_file(bad_env)

    bad_quotes = tmp_path / "quotes.env"
    bad_quotes.write_text('EVALFORGE_DATASET="unterminated\n', encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError, match="Malformed quoted value"):
        parse_env_file(bad_quotes)


def test_parse_metric_spec_and_env_errors(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    s1 = parse_metric_spec_text("precision_at_k:k=3,match_parent_id=true")
    assert s1.metric_id == "precision_at_k"
    assert s1.params == {"k": 3, "match_parent_id": True}

    s2 = parse_metric_spec_text('custom_rubric:{"rubric":"Grade clarity","require_context":true}')
    assert s2.params["rubric"] == "Grade clarity"

    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError):
        parse_metric_spec_text("   ")
    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError):
        parse_metric_spec_text("precision_at_k:badparam")
    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError):
        parse_metric_spec_text("precision_at_k:{badjson}")

    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError, match="EVALFORGE_MAX_CONCURRENCY"):
        resolve_cli_config(cwd=tmp_path, environ={"EVALFORGE_MAX_CONCURRENCY": "abc"})
    with pytest.raises(ConfigurationError, match="EVALFORGE_STRICT"):
        resolve_cli_config(cwd=tmp_path, environ={"EVALFORGE_STRICT": "maybe"})

"""Unit tests for pure reporting diagnostics, Three-Way Markdown, and redaction."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from evalforge_maestro.reporting import (
    build_calibration_report,
    build_comparison_report,
    build_run_report,
    build_trend_report,

        package_version="0.5.0",
        dataset_id="rag-bench",
        dataset_fingerprint="a" * 64,
        evaluated_case_count=2,
        system_version="v1.0",
        model_id="mock-app",
        config_fingerprint="b" * 64,
        judge_config_fingerprint="c" * 64,
        metric_versions={"exact_match": "1.0.0", "precision_at_k": "1.0.0"},
        aggregates={
            "exact_match": AggregateMetricSummary(
                metric_id="exact_match",
                metric_version="1.0.0",
                mean_score=0.5,
                applicable_count=2,
                pass_count=1,
                fail_count=1,
            ),
            "precision_at_k": AggregateMetricSummary(
                metric_id="precision_at_k",
                metric_version="1.0.0",
                mean_score=0.5,
                applicable_count=2,
                pass_count=1,
                fail_count=1,
            ),
        },
        status_counts={MetricStatus.PASS: 2, MetricStatus.FAIL: 2},
        mandatory_failed_case_ids=["c2"],
        has_mandatory_failures=True,

                case_id="c1",

                    case_id="c1",

                    retrieved_chunks=[RetrievedChunk(id="off-topic", text="Noise")],
                    elapsed_seconds=0.01,
                ),
                metrics={
                    "exact_match": MetricResult(
                        metric_id="exact_match",
                        metric_version="1.0.0",
                        score=1.0,
                        status=MetricStatus.PASS,
                        explanation="Exact match.",

                        metric_id="precision_at_k",
                        metric_version="1.0.0",
                        score=0.0,

def test_detect_decoupled_evidence_and_three_way_markdown_with_redaction() -> None:
    run = _sample_run(include_secret=True)
    decoupled = detect_decoupled_evidence(run)
    assert len(decoupled) == 2
    assert decoupled[0].case_id == "c1"
    assert decoupled[0].category.value == "answer_passed_retrieval_or_grounding_failed"
    assert decoupled[1].case_id == "c2"
    assert decoupled[1].category.value == "retrieval_passed_answer_or_grounding_failed"

    gate = QualityGateResult(
        decision=GateDecision.FAIL,
        candidate_run_id=run.run_id,
        passed=False,
        blocking=True,
        inconclusive_rate=0.0,
        checks=[
            GateRuleCheck(
                rule_id="mandatory_cases",
                status=GateDecision.FAIL,
                message="Mandatory case c2 failed.",
                observed=1,
                threshold=0,
            )
        ],
        failure_reasons=["Mandatory case c2 failed."],
        anomalies=[
            AnomalyFlag(
                anomaly_type=AnomalyType.METRIC_DISAGREEMENT,
                severity=AnomalySeverity.WARNING,
                scope=AnomalyScope.CASE,
                case_id="c1",
                metric_ids=["exact_match", "precision_at_k"],
                spread=1.0,
                explanation="Sub-metrics diverged by 1.0.",
            )
        ],
        drift_warnings=[
            DriftWarning(
                category=DriftCategory.METRIC_VERSION,
                metric_id="exact_match",
                baseline_value="0.9.0",
                candidate_value="1.0.0",
                explanation="Metric version bumped.",
            )
        ],
        summary="QualityGate=FAIL",
    )

    doc = build_run_report(run, gate=gate)
    md = render_markdown(doc)
    assert "## Evaluation" in md
    assert "## Regression" in md
    assert "## Acceptance / Quality Gate" in md
    assert "## Diagnostics & Anomalies" in md
    assert md.index("## Evaluation") < md.index("## Regression") < md.index(
        "## Acceptance / Quality Gate"
    )
    assert "### Evidence Decoupling Findings" in md
    assert "### Anti-Masking & Disagreement Anomalies" in md
    assert "### Cross-Version Provenance Drift Warnings" in md
    assert "secret_leak_abc" not in md
    assert "[REDACTED]" in md

    raw_json = render_report_json(doc)
    assert "secret_leak_abc" not in raw_json
    parsed = json.loads(raw_json)
    assert parsed["schema_version"] == "1.0"
    assert parsed["report_kind"] == "run"


def test_compare_trend_and_calibration_report_builders() -> None:
    cmp_rep = RunComparisonReport(
        baseline_run_id="base-1",
        candidate_run_id="cand-2",
        baseline_name="prod",
        target_changes=TargetChangeSummary(),
        metric_comparisons={
            "exact_match": MetricComparison(
                metric_id="exact_match",
                baseline_version="1.0.0",
                candidate_version="1.0.0",
                baseline_score=0.9,
                candidate_score=0.8,
                delta=-0.1,
                direction=ComparisonDirection.REGRESSED,
            )
        },
        matched_case_count=1,
        regressed_case_ids=["c2"],
    )
    cmp_doc = build_comparison_report(cmp_rep)
    cmp_md = render_markdown(cmp_doc)
    assert "Pairwise Comparison" in cmp_md
    assert "-0.1" in cmp_md

    trend_rep = TrendReport(
        window=3,
        inspected_run_ids=["r1", "r2"],
        slope_threshold=0.01,
        metrics={
            "exact_match": MetricTrendSummary(
                metric_id="exact_match",
                window_runs=2,
                valid_points=2,
                missing_points=0,
                slope=-0.05,
                direction=TrendDirection.DEGRADING,
                first_score=0.9,
                last_score=0.85,
                min_score=0.85,
                max_score=0.9,
                mean_score=0.875,
                explanation="Degrading slope.",
            )
        },
    )
    trend_doc = build_trend_report(trend_rep)
    trend_md = render_markdown(trend_doc)
    assert "Sliding Window Trend" in trend_md
    assert "DEGRADING" in trend_md

    cfg = JudgeConfig(mock_mode=True, local_only=True)
    cal_rep = CalibrationReport(
        metric_id="groundedness",
        metric_version="1.0.0",
        judge_config=cfg,
        judge_config_fingerprint=cfg.fingerprint,
        total_cases=2,
        valid_cases=2,
        inconclusive_cases=0,
        pass_threshold_evaluated=0.5,
        human_threshold_evaluated=0.5,
        exact_agreement_rate=50.0,
        too_generous_rate=0.5,
        too_harsh_rate=0.0,
        mean_human_score=0.4,
        mean_judge_score=0.75,
        mean_score_delta=0.35,
        disagreements=[
            CalibrationDisagreement(
                case_id="cal-2",
                disagreement_type=CalibrationDisagreementType.TOO_GENEROUS,
                human_score=0.1,
                human_passed=False,
                judge_score=0.9,
                judge_status=MetricStatus.PASS,
                judge_passed=True,
                score_delta=0.8,
                judge_rationale="Token sk-calibration-secret-key999 leaked",
            )
        ],
        recommended_pass_threshold=0.7,
    )
    cal_doc = build_calibration_report(cal_rep, min_agreement=80.0, strict=True)
    assert cal_doc.calibration_gate is not None
    assert cal_doc.calibration_gate.passed is False
    cal_md = render_markdown(cal_doc)
    assert "Calibration Disagreements" in cal_md
    assert "sk-calibration-secret-key999" not in cal_md

"""Contract tests validating Milestone 5 schemas against merged M1-M5 Draft 2020-12."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import jsonschema

from evalforge_maestro.reporting import build_run_report
from evalforge_maestro.types import (
    AggregateMetricSummary,
    BaselineCommandPayload,
    BaselineEntry,
    CaseEvaluationRecord,
    CLIErrorPayload,
    CLIResolvedConfig,
    ConfigSettingProvenance,
    ConfigSourceTier,
    ConfigValidationPayload,
    ExecutionResult,
    MetricResult,
    MetricSpecConfig,
    MetricStatus,
    RunRecord,
)


def _merged_m5_schema() -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    defs: dict[str, Any] = {}
    m5: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for rel_path in (
        "specs/001-evaluation-foundation/contracts/schemas-v1.json",
        "specs/002-retrieval-rag-evaluation/contracts/schemas-v1.json",
        "specs/003-experiment-regression-engine/contracts/schemas-v1.json",
        "specs/004-judge-calibration-engine/contracts/schemas-v1.json",
        "specs/005-cli-reporting-ci/contracts/schemas-v1.json",
    ):
        doc = json.loads(Path(rel_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        defs.update(doc["$defs"])
        m5 = doc
    merged = {"$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$defs": defs}
    jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.check_schema(merged)
    return merged, m5


def _validate_def(schema_root: dict[str, Any], def_name: str, instance: Any) -> None:
    validator = jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(
        {"$ref": f"#/$defs/{def_name}", "$defs": schema_root["$defs"]}
    )
    validator.validate(instance)


def test_m5_schema_contract_is_valid_draft_2020_12() -> None:
    merged, m5 = _merged_m5_schema()
    assert {
        "ConfigSourceTier",
        "TargetType",
        "ReportKind",
        "EvidenceDecouplingCategory",
        "MetricSpecConfig",
        "CLIResolvedConfig",
        "ReportDocument",
        "BaselineCommandPayload",
        "ConfigValidationPayload",
        "CLIErrorPayload",
    } <= set(m5["$defs"])
    assert len(merged["$defs"]) >= 61


def test_m5_runtime_models_validate_against_contract_schemas() -> None:
    merged, _ = _merged_m5_schema()

    cfg = CLIResolvedConfig(
        dataset="eval.jsonl",
        metrics=[MetricSpecConfig(metric_id="exact_match")],
        provenance=[
            ConfigSettingProvenance(
                key="judge.api_key",
                value="sk-should-redact",
                source=ConfigSourceTier.ENV,
            )
        ],
    )
    _validate_def(merged, "CLIResolvedConfig", cfg.model_dump(mode="json"))

    run = RunRecord(
        run_id="run-schema-1",
        timestamp=datetime(2026, 11, 19, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        package_version="0.5.0",
        dataset_id="ds-1",
        dataset_fingerprint="a" * 64,
        evaluated_case_count=1,
        metric_versions={"exact_match": "1.0.0"},
        aggregates={
            "exact_match": AggregateMetricSummary(
                metric_id="exact_match",
                metric_version="1.0.0",
                mean_score=1.0,
                applicable_count=1,
                pass_count=1,
            )
        },
        status_counts={MetricStatus.PASS: 1},
        case_results=[
            CaseEvaluationRecord(
                case_id="c1",
                execution=ExecutionResult(
                    case_id="c1", input="q", output="a", elapsed_seconds=0.01
                ),
                metrics={
                    "exact_match": MetricResult(
                        metric_id="exact_match",
                        metric_version="1.0.0",
                        score=1.0,
                        status=MetricStatus.PASS,
                        explanation="ok",
                    )
                },
            )
        ],
    )
    report_doc = build_run_report(run)
    _validate_def(merged, "ReportDocument", report_doc.model_dump(mode="json"))

    entry = BaselineEntry(
        name="prod",
        run_id="run-schema-1",
        pinned_at=datetime(2026, 11, 19, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        dataset_id="ds-1",
        dataset_fingerprint="a" * 64,
        metric_versions={"exact_match": "1.0.0"},
        aggregate_scores={"exact_match": 1.0},
    )
    base_payload = BaselineCommandPayload(action="set", entry=entry, baselines=[entry])
    _validate_def(merged, "BaselineCommandPayload", base_payload.model_dump(mode="json"))

    val_payload = ConfigValidationPayload(
        valid=True,
        config_path="evalforge.toml",
        warnings=["Plaintext key detected"],
    )
    _validate_def(merged, "ConfigValidationPayload", val_payload.model_dump(mode="json"))

    err_payload = CLIErrorPayload(
        exit_code=4,
        error_type="LocalOnlyPolicyError",
        message="Blocked remote endpoint",
        hint="Use --mock",
    )
    _validate_def(merged, "CLIErrorPayload", err_payload.model_dump(mode="json"))

"""Integration tests covering CLI subcommands, streams, redaction, and POSIX exit codes 0-4."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import stat
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from evalforge_maestro._canonical import REDACTED_VALUE
from evalforge_maestro.cli import main as cli_main
from evalforge_maestro.types import (
    BaselineCommandPayload,
    CLIErrorPayload,
    CLIResolvedConfig,
    ConfigValidationPayload,
    GateDecision,
    ReportDocument,
)


def _write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    path.write_text(
        "\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in rows) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def _run_cli(
    argv: list[str],
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
    capsys.readouterr()
    code = cli_main(argv)
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    return code, captured.out, captured.err


def _seed_sample_dataset(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    ds_path = tmp_path / "dataset.jsonl"
    exec_path = tmp_path / "executions.jsonl"
    _write_jsonl(
        ds_path,
        [
            {
                "id": "c1",
                "input": "What is our uptime SLA?",
                "reference": "99.9%",
                "expected_context": ["doc-sla"],
                "criteria": {"mandatory": True},
            },
            {
                "id": "c2",
                "input": "What is the support email tier?",
                "reference": "24/7 enterprise",
                "expected_context": ["doc-support"],
                "criteria": {"mandatory": False},
            },
        ],
    )
    _write_jsonl(
        exec_path,
        [
            {
                "case_id": "c1",
                "input": "What is our uptime SLA?",
                "output": "99.9%",
                "retrieved_chunks": [
                    {"id": "doc-sla", "text": "Our uptime SLA is 99.9% monthly.", "rank": 1}
                ],
                "elapsed_seconds": 0.01,
                "system_version": "app-v1",
                "model_id": "mock-rag",
            },
            {
                "case_id": "c2",
                "input": "What is the support email tier?",
                "output": "24/7 enterprise",
                "retrieved_chunks": [
                    {"id": "doc-support", "text": "24/7 enterprise support included.", "rank": 1}
                ],
                "elapsed_seconds": 0.01,
                "system_version": "app-v1",
                "model_id": "mock-rag",
            },
        ],
    )
    return ds_path, exec_path


@pytest.mark.gate_determinism
def test_cli_run_mock_local_only_determinism_and_stream_hygiene(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    ds_path, exec_path = _seed_sample_dataset(tmp_path)

    docs: list[ReportDocument] = []
    for idx in (1, 2):
        md_file = tmp_path / f"report-{idx}.md"
        json_file = tmp_path / f"report-{idx}.json"
        code, out, err = _run_cli(
            [
                "run",
                "--dataset",
                str(ds_path),
                "--executions",
                str(exec_path),
                "--metric",
                "exact_match",
                "--metric",
                "precision_at_k:k=1",
                "--metric",
                "groundedness",
                "--mock",
                "--local-only",
                "--strict",
                "--seed",
                "42",
                "--log-level",
                "INFO",
                "--log-json",
                "--json",
                "--json-out",
                str(json_file),
                "--markdown-out",
                str(md_file),
            ],
            capsys,
        )
        assert code == 0, err
        # stdout MUST be solely one schema-validated JSON payload
        doc = ReportDocument.model_validate_json(out.strip())
        docs.append(doc)
        assert doc.gate is not None
        assert doc.gate.decision == GateDecision.PASS
        assert md_file.is_file() and "## Acceptance / Quality Gate" in md_file.read_text()
        assert json_file.is_file()

        # stderr MUST hold valid JSON lines when --log-json + INFO enabled
        err_lines = [line for line in err.splitlines() if line.strip()]
        assert err_lines
        for line in err_lines:
            parsed_log = json.loads(line)
            assert parsed_log["level"] in {"INFO", "WARNING", "DEBUG", "ERROR"}

    # Repeated --mock --local-only CLI runs must match identically modulo volatile timestamps/run_id
    r1, r2 = docs[0].evaluation, docs[1].evaluation
    assert r1 is not None and r2 is not None
    assert r1.run_id != r2.run_id
    assert r1.dataset_fingerprint == r2.dataset_fingerprint
    assert r1.judge_config_fingerprint == r2.judge_config_fingerprint
    assert r1.aggregates == r2.aggregates
    assert r1.status_counts == r2.status_counts
    assert docs[0].gate == docs[1].gate

    # Verify atomic 0o700 / 0o600 permissions inside .evalforge
    if os.name == "posix":
        run_file = tmp_path / ".evalforge" / "runs" / f"{r1.run_id}.json"
        assert stat.S_IMODE((tmp_path / ".evalforge").stat().st_mode) == 0o700
        assert stat.S_IMODE(run_file.stat().st_mode) == 0o600


def test_cli_run_live_callable_rag_and_missing_docpipe_extra(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    target_mod = tmp_path / "sample_targets.py"
    target_mod.write_text(
        "def echo_answer(query: str) -> str:\n"
        "    return '99.9%'\n\n"
        "def rag_answer(query: str) -> dict:\n"
        "    return {\n"
        "        'answer': '99.9%',\n"
        "        'chunks': [{'id': 'doc-sla', 'text': '99.9% SLA'}],\n"
        "    }\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    ds_path = tmp_path / "live_ds.jsonl"
    _write_jsonl(
        ds_path,
        [
            {
                "id": "q1",
                "input": "SLA?",
                "reference": "99.9%",
                "expected_context": ["doc-sla"],
            }
        ],
    )

    code_c, out_c, _ = _run_cli(
        [
            "run",
            "--dataset",
            str(ds_path),
            "--target-type",
            "callable",
            "--target",
            "sample_targets:echo_answer",
            "--metric",
            "exact_match",
            "--json",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code_c == 0
    assert ReportDocument.model_validate_json(out_c).evaluation is not None

    code_r, out_r, _ = _run_cli(
        [
            "run",
            "--dataset",
            str(ds_path),
            "--target-type",
            "rag",
            "--target",
            "sample_targets:rag_answer",
            "--metric",
            "exact_match",
            "--metric",
            "precision_at_k:k=1",
            "--json",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code_r == 0
    rep_r = ReportDocument.model_validate_json(out_r)
    assert rep_r.evaluation is not None
    assert rep_r.evaluation.aggregates["precision_at_k"].mean_score == 1.0

    # docpipe optional extra missing -> exit 3 with actionable install hint
    code_dp, out_dp, err_dp = _run_cli(
        [
            "run",
            "--dataset",
            str(ds_path),
            "--target-type",
            "docpipe",
            "--metric",
            "exact_match",
            "--json",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code_dp == 3
    err_obj = CLIErrorPayload.model_validate_json(out_dp)
    assert err_obj.exit_code == 3
    assert "docpipe" in err_dp


def test_cli_run_exit_codes_1_2_3_4_and_quiet_stream_control(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    ds_path, exec_path = _seed_sample_dataset(tmp_path)

    # Exit 1: mandatory case breach / threshold fail
    bad_exec = tmp_path / "bad_exec.jsonl"
    _write_jsonl(
        bad_exec,
        [
            {
                "case_id": "c1",
                "input": "SLA?",
                "output": "wrong",
                "retrieved_chunks": [],
                "elapsed_seconds": 0.01,
            },
            {
                "case_id": "c2",
                "input": "Support?",
                "output": "24/7 enterprise",
                "retrieved_chunks": [],
                "elapsed_seconds": 0.01,
            },
        ],
    )
    code1, out1, _ = _run_cli(
        [
            "run",
            "--dataset",
            str(ds_path),
            "--executions",
            str(bad_exec),
            "--metric",
            "exact_match",
            "--quiet",
            "--markdown-out",
            str(tmp_path / "quiet.md"),
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code1 == 1
    assert out1 == ""
    assert (tmp_path / "quiet.md").is_file()

    # Exit 2: zero configured metrics
    code2_nom, out2_nom, _ = _run_cli(
        ["run", "--dataset", str(ds_path), "--executions", str(exec_path), "--json"],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code2_nom == 2
    assert CLIErrorPayload.model_validate_json(out2_nom).exit_code == 2

    # Exit 2: unknown metric, invalid parser arg with --json, missing replay case
    code2_badflag, out2_badflag, err2_badflag = _run_cli(
        ["run", "--unknown-flag", "--json"],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code2_badflag == 2
    assert CLIErrorPayload.model_validate_json(out2_badflag).exit_code == 2
    assert "error:" in err2_badflag

    partial_exec = tmp_path / "partial_exec.jsonl"
    _write_jsonl(
        partial_exec,
        [{"case_id": "c1", "input": "q", "output": "99.9%", "elapsed_seconds": 0.01}],
    )
    code2_miss, _, err2_miss = _run_cli(
        [
            "run",
            "--dataset",
            str(ds_path),
            "--executions",
            str(partial_exec),
            "--metric",
            "exact_match",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code2_miss == 2
    assert "c2" in err2_miss

    # Extra unused trace records emit warning on stderr while succeeding cleanly
    extra_exec = tmp_path / "extra_exec.jsonl"
    _write_jsonl(
        extra_exec,
        [
            {"case_id": "c1", "input": "q1", "output": "99.9%", "elapsed_seconds": 0.01},
            {"case_id": "c2", "input": "q2", "output": "24/7 enterprise", "elapsed_seconds": 0.01},
            {"case_id": "extra-unused", "input": "q3", "output": "unused", "elapsed_seconds": 0.01},
        ],
    )
    code_extra, _, err_extra = _run_cli(
        [
            "run",
            "--dataset",
            str(ds_path),
            "--executions",
            str(extra_exec),
            "--metric",
            "exact_match",
            "--json",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code_extra == 0
    assert "unused trace record" in err_extra

    # Exit 3: target failing on all cases (--fail-fast AND without --fail-fast) + missing judges extra
    fail_mod = tmp_path / "failing_targets.py"
    fail_mod.write_text(
        "def always_boom(query: str) -> str:\n    raise RuntimeError('upstream down')\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    for extra_flag in (["--fail-fast"], []):
        code3, out3, _ = _run_cli(
            [
                "run",
                "--dataset",
                str(ds_path),
                "--target",
                "failing_targets:always_boom",
                "--metric",
                "exact_match",
                "--json",
                *extra_flag,
            ],
            capsys,
        )
        assert code3 == 3
        assert CLIErrorPayload.model_validate_json(out3).exit_code == 3

    code3_judge, out3_judge, err3_judge = _run_cli(
        [
            "run",
            "--dataset",
            str(ds_path),
            "--executions",
            str(exec_path),
            "--metric",
            "groundedness",
            "--judge-model",
            "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
            "--json",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code3_judge == 3
    assert CLIErrorPayload.model_validate_json(out3_judge).exit_code == 3
    assert "judges" in err3_judge

    # Exit 4: --local-only blocks remote judge model pre-network
    code4_loc, out4_loc, _ = _run_cli(
        [
            "run",
            "--dataset",
            str(ds_path),
            "--executions",
            str(exec_path),
            "--metric",
            "groundedness",
            "--judge-model",
            "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
            "--local-only",
            "--json",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code4_loc == 4
    assert CLIErrorPayload.model_validate_json(out4_loc).exit_code == 4

    # Exit 4: --block-pii blocks outbound PII before remote judge dispatch without echoing raw PII
    pii_ds = tmp_path / "pii_ds.jsonl"
    pii_exec = tmp_path / "pii_exec.jsonl"
    raw_email = "secret.alice@privatecorp.com"
    _write_jsonl(pii_ds, [{"id": "p1", "input": f"Email {raw_email}", "reference": "ok"}])
    _write_jsonl(
        pii_exec,
        [
            {
                "case_id": "p1",
                "input": f"Email {raw_email}",
                "output": "ok",
                "retrieved_chunks": [{"id": "c1", "text": f"Contact {raw_email}"}],
                "elapsed_seconds": 0.01,
            }
        ],
    )
    code4_pii, out4_pii, err4_pii = _run_cli(
        [
            "run",
            "--dataset",
            str(pii_ds),
            "--executions",
            str(pii_exec),
            "--metric",
            "groundedness",
            "--judge-model",
            "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
            "--block-pii",
            "--json",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert code4_pii == 4
    assert raw_email not in out4_pii
    assert raw_email not in err4_pii
    assert CLIErrorPayload.model_validate_json(out4_pii).exit_code == 4


@pytest.mark.gate_immutability
def test_cli_baseline_compare_trend_and_report_lifecycle(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    ds_path = tmp_path / "ds.jsonl"

        ds_path,
        [
            {"id": "c1", "input": "Q1", "reference": "good"},
            {"id": "c2", "input": "Q2", "reference": "good"},
        ],
    )

    # Empty store trend returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA (exit 0 normally, exit 1 with --strict)
    code_empty_t, out_empty_t, _ = _run_cli(["trend", "--window", "3", "--json"], capsys)
    assert code_empty_t == 0
    assert ReportDocument.model_validate_json(out_empty_t).trend is not None

    code_empty_strict, _, _ = _run_cli(["trend", "--window", "3", "--strict"], capsys)
    assert code_empty_strict == 1

    # Invalid trend window < 2 -> exit 2
    code_bad_w, _, _ = _run_cli(["trend", "--window", "1"], capsys)
    assert code_bad_w == 2

    # Record 3 runs: 1.0 -> 0.5 -> 0.0
    run_ids: list[str] = []

        ex = tmp_path / f"exec_{idx}.jsonl"
        _write_jsonl(
            ex,
            [
                {"case_id": "c1", "input": "Q1", "output": outputs[0], "elapsed_seconds": 0.01},
                {"case_id": "c2", "input": "Q2", "output": outputs[1], "elapsed_seconds": 0.01},
            ],
        )
        rid = f"run-seq-{idx}"
        code, _, _ = _run_cli(
            [
                "run",
                "--dataset",
                str(ds_path),
                "--executions",
                str(ex),
                "--metric",
                "exact_match",
                "--run-id",
                rid,
                "--quiet",
            ],
            capsys,
        )
        assert code == 0
        run_ids.append(rid)

    run1_file = tmp_path / ".evalforge" / "runs" / f"{run_ids[0]}.json"
    run1_sha_before = hashlib.sha256(run1_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

    # Baseline set, list, show, duplicate rejection, overwrite, delete
    c_set, out_set, _ = _run_cli(
        [
            "baseline",
            "set",
            run_ids[0],
            "--name",
            "release",
            "--note",
            "initial golden",
            "--json",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert c_set == 0
    assert BaselineCommandPayload.model_validate_json(out_set).entry is not None

    c_dup, _, _ = _run_cli(
        ["baseline", "set", run_ids[1], "--name", "release"],
        capsys,
    )
    assert c_dup == 2

    c_ow, _, _ = _run_cli(
        ["baseline", "set", run_ids[1], "--name", "release", "--overwrite", "--json"],
        capsys,
    )
    assert c_ow == 0
    # Restore release -> run 0 for regression comparison
    _run_cli(
        ["baseline", "set", run_ids[0], "--name", "release", "--overwrite"],
        capsys,
    )

    c_list, out_list, _ = _run_cli(["baseline", "list", "--json"], capsys)
    assert c_list == 0
    assert len(BaselineCommandPayload.model_validate_json(out_list).baselines) == 1

    c_show, out_show, _ = _run_cli(["baseline", "show", "release", "--json"], capsys)
    assert c_show == 0
    assert BaselineCommandPayload.model_validate_json(out_show).entry is not None

    # Compare run-seq-3 against pinned baseline -> regression FAIL (exit 1)
    cmp_json_file = tmp_path / "cmp-report.json"
    c_cmp, out_cmp, _ = _run_cli(
        [
            "compare",
            run_ids[2],
            "--baseline",
            "release",
            "--max-regression-drop",
            "0.1",
            "--json",
            "--json-out",
            str(cmp_json_file),

    assert c_cmp == 1

def test_cli_calibrate_and_config_precedence_with_secret_masking(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)

    # Calibration samples
    cal_path = tmp_path / "cal.jsonl"
    _write_jsonl(
        cal_path,
        [
            {
                "case_id": "cal-1",
                "input": "What is uptime SLA?",
                "output": "99.9% monthly uptime SLA",
                "retrieved_chunks": [{"id": "d1", "text": "99.9% monthly uptime SLA"}],
                "human_passed": True,
            },
            {
                "case_id": "cal-2",
                "input": "What is refund window?",
                "output": "Instant cryptocurrency refund guaranteed",
                "retrieved_chunks": [{"id": "d2", "text": "Refunds take 14 business days."}],
                "human_passed": False,
            },
        ],
    )

    c_cal, out_cal, _ = _run_cli(
        [
            "calibrate",
            "--samples",
            str(cal_path),
            "--metric",
            "groundedness",
            "--mock",
            "--local-only",
            "--min-agreement",
            "50",
            "--json",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert c_cal == 0
    cal_doc = ReportDocument.model_validate_json(out_cal)
    assert cal_doc.calibration is not None
    assert cal_doc.calibration.exact_agreement_rate is not None

    # Failing min-agreement > 100 boundary (validation exit 2) vs achievable fail (exit 1)
    c_cal_fail, _, _ = _run_cli(
        [
            "calibrate",
            "--samples",
            str(cal_path),
            "--metric",
            "answer_correctness",
            "--mock",
            "--min-agreement",
            "99.9",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    # Note answer_correctness with missing references yields INCONCLUSIVE -> 0 valid cases -> fail (exit 1)
    assert c_cal_fail == 1

    # Config precedence & secret masking across config show --resolved and config validate
    raw_secret = "sk-live-secret-never-leak-777"
    (tmp_path / "evalforge.toml").write_text(
        f'[run]\ndataset = "from-toml.jsonl"\n\n[judge]\nmodel = "mock-judge"\napi_key = "{raw_secret}"\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    env_file = tmp_path / "local.env"
    env_file.write_text("EVALFORGE_MAX_CONCURRENCY=6\n", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setenv("EVALFORGE_BASELINE", "env-base")

    c_cfg, out_cfg, err_cfg = _run_cli(
        [
            "config",
            "show",
            "--resolved",
            "--env-file",
            str(env_file),
            "--json",
        ],
        capsys,
    )
    assert c_cfg == 0
    assert raw_secret not in out_cfg
    assert raw_secret not in err_cfg
    resolved = CLIResolvedConfig.model_validate_json(out_cfg)
    assert resolved.judge.api_key == REDACTED_VALUE
    assert resolved.baseline == "env-base"
    assert resolved.execution.max_concurrency == 6
    assert "Plaintext judge.api_key" in err_cfg

    c_val, out_val, err_val = _run_cli(["config", "validate", "--json"], capsys)
    assert c_val == 0
    assert raw_secret not in out_val
    assert raw_secret not in err_val
    val_payload = ConfigValidationPayload.model_validate_json(out_val)
    assert val_payload.valid is True
    assert len(val_payload.warnings) == 1
