Here is the step-by-step walkthrough for the full **dogfood → `docs/future-features.md` → M6** sequence, using exact CLI flags and schemas from [parser.py](file:///home/maestro/LifeFolder/10_PUBLIC/projects/evalforge-maestro/src/evalforge_maestro/cli/parser.py), [config.py](file:///home/maestro/LifeFolder/10_PUBLIC/projects/evalforge-maestro/src/evalforge_maestro/cli/config.py), and [types.py](file:///home/maestro/LifeFolder/10_PUBLIC/projects/evalforge-maestro/src/evalforge_maestro/types.py).

---

### Phase 1 — Live Dogfooding of `v0.1.3` (outside the repo)

#### 1.1 Create an isolated venv with real extras
Choose `[judges]` (LiteLLM) alone, or include `[docpipe]` if testing against a `docpipe-maestro` collection:

```bash
mkdir -p /tmp/evalforge-dogfood && cd /tmp/evalforge-dogfood
uv venv .venv --python 3.12

# Judges only:
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python "evalforge-maestro[judges]==0.1.3"
# Or both Docpipe + Judges:
# uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python "evalforge-maestro[docpipe,judges]==0.1.3"
```

#### 1.2 Create a small calibration dataset & run `calibrate`
Create `/tmp/evalforge-dogfood/cal-samples.jsonl` matching `HumanCalibrationSample` ([types.py](file:///home/maestro/LifeFolder/10_PUBLIC/projects/evalforge-maestro/src/evalforge_maestro/types.py#L1501-L1513)):

```bash
cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/evalforge-dogfood/cal-samples.jsonl
{"case_id": "cal-1", "input": "What is the uptime SLA?", "output": "99.9% monthly uptime SLA.", "retrieved_chunks": [{"id": "doc-sla", "text": "EvalForge Pro provides a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA."}], "human_score": 1.0}
{"case_id": "cal-2", "input": "What is the uptime SLA?", "output": "99.9% monthly uptime SLA plus free GPU credits.", "retrieved_chunks": [{"id": "doc-sla", "text": "EvalForge Pro provides a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA."}], "human_score": 0.0}
EOF
```

Run calibration against either a **local loopback model** (works with `--local-only`) or a **remote provider** (tests `EVALFORGE_JUDGE_API_KEY` + `--block-pii` pre-network scanning):

```bash
# Option A: Local loopback model (e.g., Ollama)
.venv/bin/evalforge-maestro calibrate \
  --samples cal-samples.jsonl \
  --metric groundedness \
  --local-only \
  --judge-model ollama/llama3.1 \
  --judge-api-base http://127.0.0.1:11434 \
  --json

# Option B: Remote API model with pre-network PII guard
export EVALFORGE_JUDGE_API_KEY="<YOUR_API_KEY>"
.venv/bin/evalforge-maestro calibrate \
  --samples cal-samples.jsonl \
  --metric groundedness \
  --block-pii \
  --judge-model openai/gpt-4o-mini \
  --json
```

Verify in the JSON output: `cal-1` passes, `cal-2` flags unsupported claim (`free GPU credits`), and `recommended_pass_threshold` / directional bias make sense.

#### 1.3 Run an end-to-end `run` → `baseline` → `compare` → `trend` loop
Using a small golden dataset (`golden.jsonl`) + either live Python code (`--target-type rag --target my_mod:answer_fn`) or two captured execution files (`baseline-exec.jsonl` and `candidate-exec.jsonl`):

```bash
# 1. Baseline run (set --judge-api-base / --local-only if using Option A above)
.venv/bin/evalforge-maestro run \
  --dataset golden.jsonl \
  --executions baseline-exec.jsonl \
  --metric normalized_match \
  --metric precision_at_k:k=1 \
  --metric groundedness \
  --judge-model openai/gpt-4o-mini \
  --block-pii \
  --json \
  --json-out run1.json \
  --markdown-out run1.md

# 2. Pin the run ID printed under .evaluation.run_id
.venv/bin/evalforge-maestro baseline set <RUN1_ID> --name main-baseline

# 3. Candidate run gated against the pinned baseline
.venv/bin/evalforge-maestro run \
  --dataset golden.jsonl \
  --executions candidate-exec.jsonl \
  --baseline main-baseline \
  --metric normalized_match \
  --metric precision_at_k:k=1 \
  --metric groundedness \
  --judge-model openai/gpt-4o-mini \
  --block-pii \
  --strict \
  --json-out run2.json \
  --markdown-out run2.md

# 4. Inspect historical OLS trend across both runs + effective redacted config
.venv/bin/evalforge-maestro trend --window 2 --json
.venv/bin/evalforge-maestro config show --resolved
```

#### 1.4 *(If testing `[docpipe]`)* Evaluate a live `docpipe-maestro` collection
From a directory with your indexed collection configured:

```bash
# Retrieval-only baseline (zero judge API calls):
.venv/bin/evalforge-maestro run \
  --target-type docpipe \
  --docpipe-mode retrieve \
  --docpipe-collection <YOUR_COLLECTION> \
  --docpipe-top-k 5 \
  --dataset golden.jsonl \
  --metric precision_at_k:k=5 \
  --metric recall_at_k:k=5 \
  --markdown-out docpipe-retrieve.md

# Full RAG answer + retrieval + live groundedness:
.venv/bin/evalforge-maestro run \
  --target-type docpipe \
  --docpipe-mode answer_detailed \
  --docpipe-collection <YOUR_COLLECTION> \
  --docpipe-top-k 5 \
  --dataset golden.jsonl \
  --metric precision_at_k:k=5 \
  --metric recall_at_k:k=5 \
  --metric groundedness \
  --judge-model openai/gpt-4o-mini \
  --block-pii \
  --strict \
  --markdown-out docpipe-full.md
```

Note any friction (error clarity, TOML ergonomics, judge prompt sensitivity, missing metrics). Clean up `/tmp/evalforge-dogfood` when finished:

```bash
rm -rf /tmp/evalforge-dogfood
```

---

### Phase 2 — Capture Post-MVP Backlog in `docs/future-features.md`

Back in `/home/maestro/LifeFolder/10_PUBLIC/projects/evalforge-maestro` on `main` (`c118795`):

1. Branch cleanly from `main`:
   ```bash
   git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
   git checkout -b docs/future-features
   ```
2. Create `docs/future-features.md` (currently referenced by [docs/intent.md](file:///home/maestro/LifeFolder/10_PUBLIC/projects/evalforge-maestro/docs/intent.md#L129-L133)) documenting:
   - Real-world dogfooding findings/enhancements from Phase 1
   - **M6:** Agent Trace Evaluation (tool sequence, argument correctness, policy checks, failure recovery, framework adapters)
   - **Future:** Statistical & embedding similarity metrics, OpenTelemetry trace ingestion, optional local SQLite index & HTTP service
3. Commit with a Conventional Commit message (`docs: ...`), push, and merge the PR into `main`.

---

### Phase 3 — Start Milestone M6 (`006-agent-trace-evaluation`)

Once you have a concrete agent target/trace format to evaluate:

1. Sync `main` and create the feature branch:
   ```bash
   git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
   ```

2. Use **`/grill-me`** first to settle M6 architectural decisions (target frameworks/trace formats, `tool_calls`/`trace` schemas, scoring rubrics, failure modes).

   - **`/speckit-specify`** → **`/speckit-clarify`** → **`/speckit-plan`** → **`/speckit-tasks`** → **`/speckit-implement`**
4. When ready to release M6 (`v0.2.0`), tag `v0.2.0` on merged `main` — [.github/workflows/release.yml](file:///home/maestro/LifeFolder/10_PUBLIC/projects/evalforge-maestro/.github/workflows/release.yml) will handle verification, TestPyPI, PyPI, and the GitHub Release automatically.

def validate_api_base(api_base: str | None) -> str | None:
    """Ensure custom endpoints are valid URLs and restrict plain HTTP to loopback hosts."""
    if api_base is None:
        return None
    parsed = urlparse(api_base)
    if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed.netloc:
        raise DocpipeError(
            f"Invalid api_base URL {api_base!r}: must start with http:// or https://"
        )
    if parsed.scheme == "http" and not _is_loopback_host(parsed.hostname):
        raise DocpipeError("Insecure remote api_base URL: must use https:// for external endpoints")
    return api_base

thinking:
The traceback points directly to `chromadb`'s `SharedSystemClient`. Both encountered errors, `KeyError: '.docpipe'` and `AttributeError: 'RustBindingsAPI' object has no attribute 'bindings'`, are explicitly referenced in the `chromadb` codebase. This suggests a likely incompatibility or misconfiguration within the ChromaDB dependency.


The `SharedSystemClient` within `chromadb` lacks locking in its system creation and release methods, making it vulnerable to race conditions. Specifically, the absence of a lock around `_create_system_if_not_exists` allows concurrent threads to potentially initialize, and then prematurely deinitialize, the system. This likely explains the `AttributeError` caused by attempting to access an attribute (`bindings`) that may have been prematurely released due to the race condition.


The `AttributeError` stems from a race condition where one thread creates a system instance but doesn't fully initialize it before another thread attempts to use it, leading to an attempt to access a non-existent attribute. The `KeyError` arises when a thread attempts to access a system that has already been released by another thread, potentially during a close operation. This suggests a critical flaw in how ChromaDB handles concurrent access to system resources.

> **"docpipe-maestro is a minimal RAG pipeline: it ingests any document, chunks it correctly, embeds it, stores it, retrieves the right sections, and optionally generates a grounded answer. It is the engine — not the app, not the framework."**

`docpipe-maestro` is a provider-agnostic, structure-aware Python RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline library and `docpipe-maestro` CLI. It solves the data-preparation and retrieval failure modes common in standard fixed-size chunkers: preserving document hierarchy, refusing to split legal or policy clauses mid-sentence, resolving intra-document cross-references, and guaranteeing that policy exceptions always stay attached to their rules.

## Why docpipe-maestro?

| Common RAG Failure Mode | How `docpipe-maestro` Solves It |
|---|---|
| **Orphaned exceptions** (*"20 days leave"* retrieved without *"except probationary hires"*) | **Parent-child retrieval + `POLICY` clause preservation** searches fine-grained child chunks and returns deduplicated full parent sections, enforced by the mandatory Reverse Safety Gate (`tests/test_reverse_safety.py`). |
| **Broken intra-document references** (*"subject to Section 4.2"* without knowing what Section 4.2 says) | **`POLICY` `CrossrefsEnricher`** (`enrichers=("crossrefs",)`) appends cycle-safe `[Crossref ...]` excerpts directly onto referring sections during Phase 1 ingestion (toggleable at query time via `--no-crossrefs` / `follow_crossrefs=False`). |
| **Exact identifiers & ranking misses in dense-only search** (`SEC-101`, `IR-15M`) | **Hybrid search + child-first reranking** pairs collocated SQLite FTS5 BM25 + dense vector RRF (`fts5_hybrid`) with optional local cross-encoder reranking (`--rerank` / `rerank=True`). |
| **Cross-corpus noise across files, sections, profiles, or dates** | **Unified `where` metadata & manifest filtering** compiles validated filter operators (`$eq`, `$ne`, `$in`, `$nin`, `$gt`, `$gte`, `$lt`, `$lte`, `$and`, `$or`) over chunk fields and manifest attributes (`profile`, `ingested_after`, `ingested_before`) with ChromaDB and FTS5 parity and zero re-ingestion. |
| **Orphaned vectors when files shrink or change** | **Transactional `doc_version` staging** writes new chunks, flips the JSON manifest atomically, and deletes stale versions afterward (with startup `sweep_uncommitted()` recovery). Failed runs leave the prior version intact. |
| **Silent embedding vector-space corruption** | **Manifest model lock** pins each collection to one `embed_model` and raises `ModelMismatchError` unless migrated explicitly via `reindex`. |
| **Hallucinations when nothing relevant matches** | **Deterministic empty-context refusal** returns `"Not found in the provided context."` without calling the LLM (`ask` checks retrieved hits automatically; `answer()`/`answer_detailed()` short-circuit when `has_context=False`). |
| **Sensitive PII stored or sent to remote LLMs** | **Opt-in pre-chunking `PiiEnricher` + outbound `guard_egress()`** redact, HMAC-tokenize, or block entities cleanly (`PiiBlockedError`), log zero-raw-PII `.audit.jsonl` records (`0o700`/`0o600`), and enforce `--local-only` pre-network across embeddings and generation. |
| **Hidden HTML/XLSX/EPUB injections & unsafe archives** | **Hardened intake** strips hidden DOM/EPUB elements (`display:none`, `hidden`, `aria-hidden`, `<template>`), skips `hidden`/`veryHidden` Excel sheets, disables RST file-inclusion/raw directives, enforces single-pass ZIP uncompressed size caps (`256 MiB`) across `.docx`/`.xlsx`/`.pptx`/`.epub`, rejects legacy `.doc`/`.xls`/`.ppt` binaries, and skips directory symlinks. |
| **Blind retrieval regressions, vendor lock-in & library bloat** | **Offline `eval` harness, Strategy registries & Library Purity** deliver reproducible `MRR` / `Precision@k` / `Recall@k` checks, 9 `@register_*` extension points, `NullHandler`-only `docpipe_maestro.log` (`--log-json` `stderr` telemetry), zero config-file reads in library code, and LiteLLM routing with zero hardcoded provider registry. |

```bash
# 2. Pull local Ollama models (one-time)

docpipe-maestro ask "When are employees not entitled to overtime?" --collection handbook --threshold 0.35
```

## Key Architecture & Core Concepts

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph P1["Phase 1: Offline Ingestion (Atomic & Transactional)"]
        A[Source Files] --> B[Intake & Format Detect]
        B --> C[Clean & Boilerplate Strip]
        C --> D["Enrichers (PII -> Crossrefs)"]
        D --> E[Structure-Aware Chunker]
        E --> F["local_only Check + Batched Embeddings"]
        F --> G[(ChromaDB + FTS5 + Manifest + .audit.jsonl)]
    end

    subgraph P2["Phase 2: Online Query (Read-Only)"]
        Q[Question] --> QE["local_only Check + Query Embed"]
        QE --> S["Child Search (Dense or fts5_hybrid RRF)"]
        S --> RR["Optional Rerank (Cross-Encoder Sigmoid)"]
        RR --> PE["Parent Expansion & max(score) Dedupe"]
        PE --> BP["Pure build_prompt() / build_chat_messages()"]
        BP -->|results > 0| EG["Egress Guard (local_only + PII Policy)"]
        EG --> LLM["Optional answer() via LiteLLM"]
        BP -->|empty results| REF["Deterministic Refusal (No LLM Call)"]
    end
```

1. **Two-Phase Separation**:
   - **Phase 1 (Offline Ingestion)**: Files $\to$ Parse $\to$ Clean $\to$ Enrich (`pii` $\to$ `crossrefs`) $\to$ Structure-Aware Chunking $\to$ Embeddings $\to$ Vector Database + `.audit.jsonl`. Correctness and crash safety matter.
   - **Phase 2 (Online Query)**: Question $\to$ Embed $\to$ Retrieve (Match Children, Return Deduplicated Parents) $\to$ Build Prompt $\to$ Egress Guard $\to$ Optional Grounded LLM Generation. Read-only and low-latency.
2. **Search Small, Return Big (Parent-Child Retrieval)**:
   - Small **child chunks** (individual clauses/paragraphs prefixed with `[Source: ... | Section: ...]`) are embedded and searched for high precision.
   - Large **parent sections** (complete contextual sections) are stored with zero-vector placeholders and returned to the prompt.
3. **Exception Preservation & Reverse Safety Gate**:
   - In policy and legal documents, a rule without its exception is actively misleading (e.g., *"Employees receive 20 days leave"* without *"unless probationary"*). In `POLICY` profile, clauses are kept intact even when exceeding target chunk size, and parent sections ensure exceptions always accompany their rules.
4. **Crash-Safe Transactional Synchronization**:
   - Ingestion maintains an atomic database-collocated manifest (`.docpipe/manifests/<collection>.json`) tracking `sha256` content hashes, `mtime`, and `doc_version` prefixes.
   - Modifying a document writes new versioned chunks, commits the manifest atomically, and deletes stale versions afterward, preventing orphaned clauses when documents shrink.
5. **Embedding Model Lock**:
   - The manifest locks the collection to the embedding model used during ingestion. Attempting to ingest or query with a different model raises `ModelMismatchError` rather than silently mixing incompatible vector spaces. Model migration is handled cleanly via `reindex`.

## Supported Formats & Limitations

| Format | Extensions | Structural & Content Extraction | Extra Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Markdown** | `.md`, `.markdown` | ATX headings (`#`–`######`), code fence awareness (` ``` ` / `~~~` ignores `# comments`) | Core install |
| **Plain Text** | `.txt` | Heuristic `Section` / `Article` / `Chapter` / `Part` and numbered headings | Core install |
| **CSV / TSV** | `.csv`, `.tsv` | Strict UTF-8 / BOM normalization, trimmed empty trailing columns, ragged-row tolerance, 25-row bounded `Header: Value` sections | Core install |
| **HTML** | `.html`, `.htm` | `<h1–h6>` headings, paragraphs, lists, tables (` \| `), strips `<script>`/`<style>`/`<nav>`/`<footer>`/`<noscript>` & hidden subtrees | `[html]` (`beautifulsoup4`) |
| **Word** | `.docx` | Word `Heading 1`–`Heading 6` styles, paragraphs, tables (` \| `) | `[docx]` (`python-docx`) |
| **PDF** | `.pdf` | Per-page text, 1-based page numbers, multi-page active heading carryover, boilerplate header/footer stripping | `[pdf]` (`pypdf`) |
| **Excel** | `.xlsx` | Visible sheets only (skips `hidden`/`veryHidden`), evaluated cached values, 25-row bounded `Header: Value` sections | `[xlsx]` (`openpyxl`) |
| **PowerPoint** | `.pptx` | Per-slide titles & 1-based page numbers, body text, grouped shapes, tables (` \| `), speaker notes | `[pptx]` (`python-pptx`) |
| **EPUB** | `.epub` | Ordered spine chapters with `<h1–h6>` section headings, offline hidden-DOM/boilerplate stripping | `[epub]` (`ebooklib`) |
| **reStructuredText** | `.rst` | Section/heading hierarchy (`heading_level`), paragraphs, lists, tables (` \| `), admonitions; local file/raw directives disabled | `[rst]` (`docutils`) |

- **Extensionless files**: `detect_format()` inspects the first 4 KiB for `%PDF-`, legacy OLE2 binaries (rejected cleanly), single-pass `PK\x03\x04` ZIP containers (`word/document.xml` → `docx`, `xl/workbook.xml` → `xlsx`, `ppt/presentation.xml` → `pptx`, `META-INF/container.xml` → `epub`), HTML root tags (`<!doctype html` / `<html`), Markdown headings, or valid UTF-8 text.
- **Current scope & limitations**:
  - Image-only / scanned PDFs without an embedded text layer yield empty text (OCR is out of scope).
  - Legacy binary `.doc`, `.xls`, and `.ppt` files are not supported (modern `.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`, or `.csv`/`.tsv` only).
  - `docpipe-maestro` is a library and CLI engine — it deliberately excludes web servers, auth layers, streaming UIs, and multi-tenant isolation.

## Installation Guide

`docpipe-maestro` requires **Python 3.10+**.

### Core Install

The core installation includes Markdown (`.md`, `.markdown`), plain text (`.txt`), CSV (`.csv`), and TSV (`.tsv`) parsing, embedding generation, ChromaDB vector storage, and semantic retrieval:

```bash
# Install from PyPI
pip install docpipe-maestro

# Or install the latest development head from GitHub:
# pip install "git+https://github.com/ivnmoreno/docpipe-maestro.git"
```

### Optional Extras

Generation (`answer()`, `ask`) is available in the base install — no extra needed. Install optional extras for additional document format parsers:

| Extra | Purpose | Dependencies Installed |
|---|---|---|
| `pdf` | Extract text, page numbers, and heuristic section headings (`Section X.Y`) from PDF files | `pypdf>=6.21.3` (BSD-3-Clause) |
| `docx` | Extract text, style-based headings (`Heading 1`–`Heading 6`), and tables from Word documents | `python-docx>=1.1.0` |
| `html` | Strip boilerplate and parse `<h1–h6>` headings from web pages / HTML exports | `beautifulsoup4>=4.12.0` |
| `xlsx` | Extract visible Excel worksheets into header-paired 25-row sections | `openpyxl>=3.1.0` |
| `pptx` | Extract numbered slides, body/tables, grouped shapes, and speaker notes from PowerPoint decks | `python-pptx>=1.0.0` |
| `epub` | Extract ordered spine chapters and headings from EPUB books safely offline | `ebooklib>=0.18` |
| `rst` | Extract structured sections and tables from reStructuredText offline (`.. include::` disabled) | `docutils>=0.20` |
| `all` | Installs **all** optional document format parsers (`pdf`, `docx`, `html`, `xlsx`, `pptx`, `epub`, `rst`) | `pypdf`, `python-docx`, `beautifulsoup4`, `openpyxl`, `python-pptx`, `ebooklib`, `docutils` |
| `rerank` | Second-stage local neural cross-encoder reranking (`BAAI/bge-reranker-base` default) | `sentence-transformers>=3.0.0` |
| `pii` | Optional multi-language NER PII recognition alongside deterministic recognizers | `presidio-analyzer>=2.2.0`, `presidio-anonymizer>=2.2.0` |

> **Note on Structure Extraction**: Markdown, plain text, CSV/TSV, HTML, DOCX, PDF, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, and RST extract headings, clauses, tables/rows, and slide/page metadata cleanly without external SaaS parsers. Note that `[all]` installs document parsers only; include `[rerank]` and/or `[pii]` alongside it (`[all,rerank,pii]`) when enabling reranking or Presidio NER. For offline `[pii]` usage, pre-install the required local spaCy models (e.g. `en_core_web_sm`, `es_core_news_sm`).

Install specific extras:
```bash
# PDF support only
pip install "docpipe-maestro[pdf]"

# PDF, DOCX, and XLSX support
pip install "docpipe-maestro[pdf,docx,xlsx]"

# Full installation with all document format parsers
pip install "docpipe-maestro[all]"

# Parsers + local cross-encoder reranking + optional NER PII detection
pip install "docpipe-maestro[all,rerank,pii]"
```

### Development Setup

To contribute or run tests locally (uses PEP 735 `[dependency-groups]`):

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/ivnmoreno/docpipe-maestro.git
cd docpipe-maestro

# Option A: Using uv (recommended)
uv sync --all-extras --group dev

# Option B: Using pip 24.1+ (PEP 735 dependency groups)
pip install --group dev -e ".[all]"
pre-commit install --hook-type commit-msg
```

> **Note on Versioning & Commitizen**: Package versions are derived dynamically from Git tags via `hatch-vcs`. Use `uv run cz check` (to validate Conventional Commits) and `uv run cz changelog` (to update `CHANGELOG.md`), rather than `cz bump`.

## Configuration Guide

`docpipe-maestro` enforces strict **Library Purity**: **no library module reads external configuration files**. Configuration is passed explicitly via function arguments or provider environment variables. Only the `docpipe-maestro` CLI optionally reads a `--config` TOML file.

### 1. Local Execution (Default: Zero Cloud Accounts Required)

Out of the box, `docpipe-maestro` defaults to local execution with [Ollama](https://ollama.com/):
- **Default Embeddings Model**: `ollama/nomic-embed-text`
- **Default Generation Model**: `ollama/llama3.2`

Make sure Ollama is installed and running (`http://localhost:11434`), then pull the default models:

```bash
ollama pull nomic-embed-text
ollama pull llama3.2
```

> **Tip — Choosing a local generation model**: For multi-section policy synthesis (especially on CPU or limited RAM), `ollama/qwen2.5:1.5b-instruct` or `ollama/qwen2.5:3b` follows retrieved context more reliably than `ollama/llama3.2` (which can over-refuse paraphrased queries) and `<1B` models (which are too small for grounded synthesis). Override the default with `--model ollama/qwen2.5:1.5b-instruct` or set `model = "ollama/qwen2.5:1.5b-instruct"` in `docpipe.toml`.

> **Air-gapped / strict zero-egress environments**: By default, `litellm` attempts to download its public model-cost JSON map from GitHub when first imported before falling back to its bundled copy. Set `export LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=true` in your shell to prevent any startup HTTP call on import.

### 2. Cloud Provider API Keys (`.env` or Shell Environment)

Copy the tracked template `.env.example` to `.env` (git-ignored) and restrict permissions:

```bash
cp .env.example .env && chmod 600 .env
```

Or export provider environment variables directly in your shell (shell variables always take precedence over `.env`):

```bash
# Groq serverless inference
export GROQ_API_KEY="your-groq-api-key"

# Together.ai serverless inference (TOGETHER_API_KEY alias is also recognized by LiteLLM)
export TOGETHERAI_API_KEY="your-together-api-key"

# OpenAI / Anthropic / Google Gemini
export OPENAI_API_KEY="your-openai-api-key"
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="your-anthropic-api-key"
export GEMINI_API_KEY="your-gemini-api-key"

# Air-gapped / offline startup cost-map safety
export LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP="true"
```

You can then pass any `provider/model` string directly to `--embed-model` or `--model` (e.g., `groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile`, `together_ai/meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo`, `openai/gpt-4o-mini`, `gemini/gemini-2.5-flash`). Note that the CLI loads `.env` strictly from the `--config` directory or current working directory (never walking parent directories), while direct Python API callers configure `os.environ`.

### 3. Local Persistence Storage Directory

By default, data is stored in `./.docpipe`:
```text
.docpipe/
├── chroma.sqlite3                    # ChromaDB embedded vector database
├── <uuid>/                           # ChromaDB vector segments and HNSW index files
├── lexical/
│   └── <collection>.db               # Collocated SQLite FTS5 BM25 lexical index (`fts5_hybrid`)
└── manifests/
    ├── <collection>.json             # Atomic JSON manifest tracking file hashes, versions, and locked model
    └── <collection>.audit.jsonl      # Append-only zero-raw-PII audit log (written when PII policy is active)
```
Customize the persistence directory with `--persist-dir` on the CLI or `persist_dir=` in Python. Never commit `.docpipe/` to version control if your corpus is private.

### 4. CLI Configuration File (`docpipe.toml`)

When `--config` is omitted (and `--no-config` is not passed), the CLI automatically loads `./docpipe.toml` from the current working directory if present (non-recursively; never walking parent directories). Create an optional TOML configuration file to set default CLI options (never store API keys or secrets here — explicit CLI flags override `--config` / `./docpipe.toml`, which override built-in defaults):

```toml
# docpipe.toml
collection = "my_kb"
persist_dir = "./data/docpipe_index"
embed_model = "ollama/nomic-embed-text"
model = "ollama/llama3.2"
profile = "POLICY"
top_k = 5
threshold = 0.4
searcher = "default"               # "default" (dense vector) or "fts5_hybrid" (dense + SQLite FTS5 RRF)
# Optional second-stage cross-encoder reranking (requires `[rerank]` extra):
# rerank = false
# reranker = "cross_encoder"
# rerank_top_n = 20
# Optional online/gateway defaults for `docpipe-maestro ask` (CLI flags override these):
# api_base = "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1"
# temperature = 0.0
# max_tokens = 512                 # Keep omitted (or >= 4096) for reasoning models
# timeout = 60.0
# fail_on_truncation = false
# Privacy & PII defaults (JSON/TOML path string or `[pii_policy]` table applied in CLI only):
# local_only = false
# pii_policy = "./pii-policy.json"
```

Pass an explicit config path with `--config`, or ignore `./docpipe.toml` with `--no-config`:
```bash
docpipe-maestro query "What is the probation period?" --config docpipe.toml
docpipe-maestro ask "What is the probation period?" --no-config
```

#### Optional PII Policy File (`--pii-policy`)

When enabling `--pii-policy ./pii-policy.json` (or `.toml`) on `ingest`, `sync`, or `ask`, configure actions (`"redact"`, `"tokenize"`, `"block"`) per entity type (`EMAIL_ADDRESS`, `IBAN_CODE`, `CREDIT_CARD`, `US_SSN`, `IP_ADDRESS`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `ES_DNI`, plus optional `[pii]` Presidio `ner: true`):

```json
{
  "types": {
    "EMAIL_ADDRESS": "tokenize",
    "IBAN_CODE": "redact",
    "US_SSN": "block"
  },
  "token_salt_env": "DOCPIPE_PII_SALT",
  "egress": "redact"
}
```
*(In `docpipe.toml`, set `pii_policy = "./pii-policy.json"` or define an inline `[pii_policy]` table. Use `token_salt_env` outside the repository for deterministic cross-run tokens.)*

### 5. Chunking Profiles (`DEFAULT`, `POLICY`, and Custom Profiles)

Built-in profiles are immutable presets (`docpipe_maestro.config`) calibrated for specific document types:

| Parameter | `DEFAULT` Profile | `POLICY` Profile |
|---|---|---|
| **Intended For** | Notes, general prose, articles, documentation | Handbooks, compliance policies, HR manuals, contracts |
| **Target Chunk Size** | ~512 tokens | ~1000 tokens |
| **Chunk Overlap** | ~64 tokens (scoped within section) | ~80 tokens (scoped within section) |
| **Clause Preservation** | Disabled (splits on sentences/paragraphs) | **Enabled** (never splits inside detected numbered clauses; PDF clause detection is heuristic) |
| **Cross-Reference Resolution** | Disabled | **Enabled** (resolves `§2.1`, `Section 4`, `Clause 3.2`) |
| **Enrichers (`enrichers`)** | `()` (skipped) | `("crossrefs",)` |
| **Parent-Child Expansion** | Enabled | **Enabled** |

> **Note on PDF Clause Detection**: Markdown, DOCX, and HTML headings/numbering provide explicit structural boundaries, whereas PDF clause detection uses extracted-text heuristics (`1.1`, `Clause 2`, `(a)` layout cues) and depends on clean PDF text extraction order.

In Python, you can also pass a custom [`ChunkingProfile`](docs/api-reference.md) instance directly to `ingest(..., profile=custom_profile)` or `sync(...)`, and configure ordered post-clean enrichers via `profile.enrichers` and `@register_enricher`.

## Quickstart: CLI Usage Guide

Run `docpipe-maestro --help` to see all available subcommands (global flags such as `--config`, `--no-config`, `--collection`, `--persist-dir`, `--local-only`, `--log-json`, and `--log-level` work either **before or after** any subcommand):

```text
usage: docpipe-maestro [-h] [--version] [--config CONFIG] [--no-config]
                       [--collection COLLECTION] [--persist-dir PERSIST_DIR]
                       [--local-only | --no-local-only]
                       [--pii-policy PII_POLICY] [--log-json]
                       [--log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}]
                       {ingest,sync,status,remove,reindex,query,ask,eval} ...
```

See the full [CLI Reference](docs/cli-reference.md) for all flags, TOML keys, exit codes, and output schemas.

### 1. Ingest Documents (`docpipe-maestro ingest`)

Ingest a single file or an entire directory tree atomically (if any file fails validation, no records are committed):

```bash
# Ingest with default profile
docpipe-maestro ingest ./docs --collection knowledge_base

# Ingest policy documents with clause-preservation and cross-reference resolution
docpipe-maestro ingest ./company_policies --profile POLICY --collection hr_policy

# Ingest strictly locally with pre-chunking PII scrubbing/blocking and .audit.jsonl output
docpipe-maestro ingest ./company_policies --local-only --pii-policy ./pii-policy.json --collection hr_policy

# Force re-ingestion even if files have not changed on disk
docpipe-maestro ingest ./docs --force --collection knowledge_base

# Ingest policies and export a self-contained offline HTML integrity & chunk audit report
docpipe-maestro ingest ./company_policies --profile POLICY --collection hr_policy --html-report ./audit.html
```

### 2. Keep Collections in Sync (`docpipe-maestro sync`)

Reconcile a target directory against the manifest (adds new files, skips unchanged files via `mtime`/`sha256`, updates modified files, and purges deleted files), or preview changes and offline token/cost estimates safely first with `--dry-run` (plus `--json` for CI gating):

```bash
# Preview deltas, chunks, tokens, and estimated cost without mutating disk or calling embedders
docpipe-maestro sync ./company_policies --profile POLICY --collection hr_policy --dry-run

# Apply reconciliation
docpipe-maestro sync ./company_policies --profile POLICY --collection hr_policy
```
**Example output**:
```text
Synced 'hr_policy': added=1, updated=2, skipped=10, removed=1.
```

### 3. Inspect Collection Status (`docpipe-maestro status`)

View indexed files, active `doc_version` hashes, chunk counts, and locked embedding model:

```bash
docpipe-maestro status --collection hr_policy
```
**Example output**:
```text
Collection: hr_policy | Model: ollama/nomic-embed-text (dim=768) | Sources: 2 | Children: 18 | Parents: 6
  - hr_leave_policy.md [4f1a29b01c3d] (10 children, 3 parents)
  - travel_expenses_policy.md [a8c2194ef001] (8 children, 3 parents)
```

Use `--json` for machine-readable output or `--html-report` to export a self-contained single-file HTML Document Integrity & Chunk Audit Report:
```bash
docpipe-maestro status --collection hr_policy --json
docpipe-maestro status --collection hr_policy --html-report ./audit.html
```

### 4. Remove a Source Document (`docpipe-maestro remove`)

Purge all child chunks, parent sections, and manifest entries for a specific file:

```bash
docpipe-maestro remove hr_leave_policy.md --collection hr_policy
```

### 5. Migrate Embedding Models (`docpipe-maestro reindex`)

Re-embed all existing child chunks stored in the database under a new embedding model, update parent vector dimensions, and re-lock the collection (or pass `--dry-run [--json]` to estimate active child chunks, tokens, and offline cost before making API calls):

```bash
# Preview active chunks and estimated embedding cost before migrating
docpipe-maestro reindex --model openai/text-embedding-3-small --collection hr_policy --dry-run

# Migrate collection to OpenAI embeddings
export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-..."
docpipe-maestro reindex --model openai/text-embedding-3-small --collection hr_policy
```

### 6. Semantic Search Without an LLM (`docpipe-maestro query`)

Perform Phase 2 semantic retrieval to inspect scored passages and provenance without invoking a language model:

```bash
# Basic semantic query
docpipe-maestro query "How many vacation days do full-time employees accrue?" --collection hr_policy

# Restrict to top 3 sections with a minimum similarity threshold (0.0 to 1.0)
docpipe-maestro query "What is the flight reimbursement policy?" --top-k 3 --threshold 0.5 --collection hr_policy

# Combine dense vector similarity with SQLite FTS5 BM25 via Reciprocal Rank Fusion
# (ideal for exact error codes, identifiers, or clauses like "SEV-1" or "AES-256")
docpipe-maestro query "SEV-1 escalation window" --searcher fts5_hybrid --collection hr_policy

# Apply optional second-stage cross-encoder reranking over top candidate child chunks
# (requires `docpipe-maestro[rerank]`)
docpipe-maestro query "SEV-1 escalation window" --searcher fts5_hybrid --rerank --rerank-top-n 20 --collection hr_policy

# Return raw child chunks instead of expanded parent sections
docpipe-maestro query "annual leave" --no-expand-parent --collection hr_policy

# Scope search by document metadata or manifest profile/ingestion window (without re-ingestion)
docpipe-maestro query "annual leave" --where profile=POLICY --where page=2 --collection hr_policy
docpipe-maestro query "annual leave" --where ingested_after=2026-01-01 --collection hr_policy

# Emit structured JSON (for evaluation fixtures and scripts) or add --log-json telemetry on stderr
docpipe-maestro query "annual leave" --json --collection hr_policy
docpipe-maestro --log-json --log-level INFO query "annual leave" --collection hr_policy 2>trace.jsonl
```

**Example output**:
```text
[1] score=0.8421 | Source: hr_leave_policy.md | Section: 3. Annual Leave
3.1 Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
3.2 Employees with less than one year of tenure accrue leave on a pro-rata basis.
------------------------------------------------------------
```

### 7. Grounded Question Answering (`docpipe-maestro ask`)

Retrieve relevant context, build a grounded prompt, and generate a citation-backed answer:

```bash
# Using local Ollama (default)
docpipe-maestro ask "How many days of leave does a first-year employee get?" --collection hr_policy

# Using a custom Ollama tag or cloud model / OpenAI-compatible base URL
docpipe-maestro ask "Summarize travel meal limits." --model ollama/qwen2.5:1.5b-instruct --collection hr_policy
export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-..."
docpipe-maestro ask "Summarize travel meal allowance limits." --model openai/gpt-4o-mini --collection hr_policy
docpipe-maestro ask "Summarize travel policy." --model openai/my-local-model --api-base http://localhost:8000/v1 --collection hr_policy

# Safe thresholding: if no retrieved content matches threshold, short-circuits with a refusal
docpipe-maestro ask "What is the recipe for lasagna?" --threshold 0.7 --collection hr_policy

# Inspect retrieved context on stderr, request JSON telemetry on stdout, stream tokens live, or fail if truncated at max_tokens
docpipe-maestro ask "Summarize travel limits." --show-context --collection hr_policy
docpipe-maestro ask "What is the SEV-1 escalation window?" --searcher fts5_hybrid --rerank --collection hr_policy
docpipe-maestro ask "How many days of annual leave do employees get?" --stream --collection hr_policy
docpipe-maestro ask "Summarize travel limits." --json --fail-on-truncation --collection hr_policy

# Enforce local-only execution pre-network or scrub outbound remote prompts via --pii-policy
docpipe-maestro ask "Summarize travel limits." --local-only --collection hr_policy
docpipe-maestro ask "Summarize travel limits." --where source=travel_policy.md --collection hr_policy
docpipe-maestro ask "Summarize employee contacts." --model openai/gpt-4o-mini --pii-policy ./pii-policy.json --collection hr_policy
```
*(By default, if a provider hits `--max-tokens` and sets `finish_reason == "length"`, `ask` prints a `Warning:` on `stderr`; pass `--fail-on-truncation` to fail non-zero instead.)*

### 8. Offline Retrieval Evaluation (`docpipe-maestro eval`)

Benchmark Phase 2 retrieval (`Precision@K`, `Recall@K`, `MRR`) against a labeled JSON fixture without mutating persisted manifests or indexes (see [Retrieval Evaluation Baselines](docs/eval-baseline.md)):

```bash
# Run curated 24-query policy benchmark with hybrid lexical + dense search
docpipe-maestro eval --fixture tests/fixtures/eval_policy_corpus.json --searcher fts5_hybrid

# Benchmark with local cross-encoder reranking enabled
docpipe-maestro eval --fixture tests/fixtures/eval_policy_corpus.json --searcher fts5_hybrid --rerank

# Customize cutoff values, filter subset by metadata, inspect raw child chunks, or emit JSON
docpipe-maestro eval --fixture tests/fixtures/eval_policy_corpus.json --where profile=POLICY --k 1 3 5 --no-expand-parent --json
```

*(Target collection resolves in order: explicit `--collection` > fixture `collection` > `docpipe.toml` `collection` > `"default"`.)*

## Python Library API Guide

See the complete [Python API Reference](docs/api-reference.md) for every signature, parameter default, config constant, and exception class.

### Phase 1: Ingestion & Lifecycle Workflow

```python
from pathlib import Path
from docpipe_maestro import PiiBlockedError, PiiPolicy, ingest, reindex, remove, status, sync

pii_policy: PiiPolicy = {
    "types": {
        "EMAIL_ADDRESS": "tokenize",
        "IBAN_CODE": "redact",
        "US_SSN": "block",
    },
    "token_salt_env": "DOCPIPE_PII_SALT",  # omit to use process-random fallback salt + warning
    "egress": "redact",
}

# 1. Ingest a document or directory with pre-chunking PII safeguards
try:
    result = ingest(
        Path("./policies"),
        profile="POLICY",  # "DEFAULT", "POLICY", or custom ChunkingProfile
        collection="handbook",
        persist_dir=".docpipe",
        embed_model="ollama/nomic-embed-text",
        pii_policy=pii_policy,
        local_only=True,
    )
    print(
        f"Ingested {len(result.ingested)} files "
        f"({result.chunks_written} children, {result.parents_written} parents)."
    )
except PiiBlockedError as exc:
    # Exception reports source & blocked entity type(s) without printing raw PII values
    print(f"Aborted cleanly on {exc.source}: {exc.blocked_entities}")

# 2. Synchronize folder after changes (adds, edits, deletions)
sync_result = sync(
    Path("./policies"),
    profile="POLICY",
    collection="handbook",
)
print(
    f"Added: {len(sync_result.added)}, Updated: {len(sync_result.updated)}, "
    f"Skipped: {len(sync_result.skipped)}, Removed: {len(sync_result.removed)}"
)

# 3. Check collection metadata and tracked documents
coll_status = status(collection="handbook")
print(
    f"Locked embed model: {coll_status.embed_model}, "
    f"Tracked files: {coll_status.total_sources}, "
    f"Children: {coll_status.total_children}"
)

# 4. Remove a document from the index
removed = remove("outdated_policy.md", collection="handbook")

# 5. Reindex collection with a new embedding model
reindexed_count = reindex(
    embed_model="openai/text-embedding-3-small",
    collection="handbook",
)
```

### Phase 2: Semantic Retrieval & Grounded RAG Workflow

```python
from docpipe_maestro import answer, build_chat_messages, retrieve

question = "What is the travel meal reimbursement rate?"

# 1. Retrieve deduplicated parent sections (pass searcher="fts5_hybrid" for dense + BM25 RRF)
retrieved_sections = retrieve(
    question=question,
    collection="handbook",
    top_k=5,
    threshold=0.35,  # Normalized similarity / RRF score [0.0, 1.0]
    expand_parent=True,  # Expand child matches to full parent section
    searcher="default",  # "default" or "fts5_hybrid"
    rerank=False,  # Set True (with `[rerank]` extra installed) for cross-encoder rescoring
    where={"profile": "POLICY"},  # Optional chunk/manifest metadata filter
)

for section in retrieved_sections:
    print(f"[{section.score:.2f}] {section.metadata['source']} - {section.metadata['section']}")
    print(section.text)

# 2. Build role-separated ChatML messages (Pure function, zero network calls)
#    (build_prompt() also remains available for single-string prompts.)
messages = build_chat_messages(question=question, sections=retrieved_sections)

# 3. Generate a grounded answer (pass stream=True for synchronous Iterator[str] chunks,
#    or use answer_detailed() for finish_reason/token telemetry)
response = answer(
    prompt=messages,
    model="ollama/llama3.2",
    temperature=0.0,  # Omit (None) for reasoning models that reject temperature
    max_tokens=512,  # Omit (None) or pass model_kwargs={"reasoning_effort": "low"} for reasoning models
    timeout=60.0,
    has_context=bool(retrieved_sections),  # Short-circuits with refusal if context is empty
)
print("Answer:\n", response)

# Incremental streaming with identical preflight/egress safety before the first pull:
for delta in answer(
    messages, model="ollama/llama3.2", has_context=bool(retrieved_sections), stream=True
):
    print(delta, end="", flush=True)
print()
```

### Core Data Shapes & Exceptions

Exported from `docpipe_maestro` (`docpipe_maestro.types`):

- `Chunk`: Base unit (`id`, `text`, `parent_id`, `metadata: ChunkMetadata`).
- `EmbeddedChunk`: `Chunk` with dense embedding (`vector: list[float]`).
- `RetrievedChunk`: `EmbeddedChunk` with normalized similarity or RRF score (`score: float` in `[0.0, 1.0]`).
- `GenerationResult`: Detailed LLM completion result (`text`, `model`, `finish_reason`, `truncated`, `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `reasoning_tokens`, `total_tokens`, `elapsed_seconds`).
- `IngestResult`: Summary (`collection`, `embed_model`, `ingested`, `skipped`, `chunks_written`, `parents_written`).
- `SyncResult`: Summary (`collection`, `embed_model`, `added`, `updated`, `skipped`, `removed`, `dry_run`, `estimated_children`, `estimated_parents`, `estimated_tokens`, `estimated_cost_usd`).
- `CollectionStatus`: Manifest overview (`collection`, `embed_model`, `embed_dim`, `total_sources`, `total_children`, `total_parents`, `sources`).
- `SourceRecord`: Per-file manifest tracking record (`source`, `content_hash`, `doc_version`, `size`, `mtime`, `ingested_at`, `embed_model`, `profile`, `chunk_ids`, `parent_ids`).
- Exceptions: `DocpipeError` (base) with `UnsupportedFormatError`, `MissingExtraError`, `ModelMismatchError`, `MissingCredentialError`, `PiiBlockedError`, and `RegistryError`.
- Privacy & Extensibility: `PiiPolicy` (`TypedDict`) passed programmatically to `ingest()`, `sync()`, `answer()`, and `answer_detailed()`, plus lazy root `@register_pii_recognizer` (`docpipe_maestro.types.PiiRecognizer`) for custom entity patterns.

## Security, Privacy & Grounding Notes

- **Trusted local corpus assumption**: Like most local ingestion tools, `docpipe-maestro ingest` processes files inside the target directory you specify. Only ingest trusted documents and avoid pointing `ingest`/`sync` at directories containing symlinks to sensitive files or untrusted HTML/PDF inputs.
- **Credentials & transport security**: API keys are never accepted in `docpipe.toml`; remote custom endpoints require `https://` (`http://` is permitted only for loopback hosts), and error handlers scrub regex key patterns as well as loaded environment secrets (`from None`) so credentials never leak in exceptions.
- **`--local-only` & outbound PII egress guard**: Pass `--local-only` (`local_only=True`) to reject non-local models and remote `--api-base` URLs prior to network requests. When calling remote LLMs with `pii_policy`, `guard_egress()` scrubs or blocks outbound prompt strings and role-separated ChatML messages before dispatch, and Phase 1 writes zero-raw-PII counts/metadata to `<persist_dir>/manifests/<collection>.audit.jsonl` under `0o700`/`0o600` permissions.
- **Opt-in structured telemetry (`docpipe_maestro.log` / `--log-json`)**: Library calls stay silent by default (`NullHandler` only on `"docpipe_maestro"`, root logger and `stdout` untouched). CLI flags `--log-json` and `--log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}` (CLI-only; ignored in `docpipe.toml`) stream correlated `stage.end` events exclusively to `stderr` with traceback suppression and zero raw documents, questions, prompts, answers, PII, or credentials at `INFO` or `DEBUG`.
- **Honest scope & accuracy limitations**: Built-in pattern/checksum recognizers (`EMAIL_ADDRESS`, `IBAN_CODE`, `CREDIT_CARD`, `US_SSN`, `IP_ADDRESS`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `ES_DNI`) and optional `[pii]` Presidio NER heuristics can experience both false positives and false negatives depending on language, formatting, custom identifiers, and OCR/PDF text noise. These safeguards reduce risk but are technical controls—not a guarantee of exhaustive redaction or regulatory certification. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for full threat-model notes.
- **Reduce hallucinations with `--threshold`**: Set a similarity `--threshold` (e.g. `0.35`–`0.6` depending on embedding model) on `retrieve()` / `docpipe-maestro ask` so off-topic questions return zero matches and short-circuit deterministically (`"Not found in the provided context."`).
- **Protect your `.docpipe/` store on shared hosts**: Embedded ChromaDB files store plaintext document sections unless scrubbed beforehand; keep `persist_dir` on owner-restricted paths (`chmod 700`) and excluded from version control.

## Safety & Verification

`docpipe-maestro` includes two mandatory automated release gates:
1. **Reverse Safety Test Gate** (`tests/test_reverse_safety.py`, `@pytest.mark.reverse`): Enforces that every clause containing an exception marker (`except`, `unless`, `not entitled`, `subject to`, `provided that`) always retrieves a parent context containing the exception alongside the general rule.
2. **PII Safety Test Gate** (`tests/test_pii_safety.py`, `@pytest.mark.pii`): Verifies offline on synthetic fixtures that blocked PII halts ingestion before database commit, redacted/tokenized spans never persist to chunks or outbound remote payloads, `--local-only` blocks remote endpoints pre-network, and `.audit.jsonl` logs zero raw PII.

## 1. Phase 1: Offline Ingestion & Corpus Lifecycle

### `ingest(...) -> IngestResult`

```python
def ingest(
    path: str | Path,
    *,
    profile: str | ChunkingProfile = "DEFAULT",
    collection: str = "default",
    persist_dir: str | Path = ".docpipe",
    embed_model: str = "ollama/nomic-embed-text",
    force: bool = False,
    cleaner: str = "default",
    chunker: str = "default",
    embedder: str = "default",
    store: str = "default",
    pii_policy: PiiPolicy | None = None,
    local_only: bool = False,
) -> IngestResult
```

Atomically ingests a single file or directory tree (recursively sorted by relative POSIX path) into ChromaDB, updates the collocated SQLite FTS5 lexical index (`<persist_dir>/lexical/<collection>.db`), and updates the collocated manifest.

- **Batch Atomicity**: Parses, cleans, enriches (including pre-chunking `PiiEnricher` when `pii_policy` is set), chunks, and embeds all changed files in memory *before* creating or modifying `VectorStore`. Any unsupported file, missing parser extra, or `PiiBlockedError` aborts the entire run cleanly.
- **PII & Audit Log**: When `pii_policy` is provided, schedules `"pii"` ahead of downstream enrichers (unless explicitly ordered in `profile.enrichers`), scrubs headings/bodies before chunking, writes `<persist_dir>/manifests/<collection>.audit.jsonl` (`0o700`/`0o600`, zero raw PII) alongside committed sources, and logs a single `blocked=True` entry only for the offending source on abort. When `local_only=True`, rejects remote `embed_model` targets pre-network.
- **Fast-Path & Hash Check**: Files with unchanged `(size, mtime)` skip disk hashing unless `force=True`; changed timestamps with identical `sha256` refresh manifest metadata without re-embedding.
- **Self-Exclusion**: Any directory matching `persist_dir` nested under `path` is automatically skipped.
- **Empty Directories**: Raises `UnsupportedFormatError` if `path` does not exist or yields zero files.

**Raises**: `UnsupportedFormatError`, `MissingExtraError`, `ModelMismatchError`, `MissingCredentialError`, `PiiBlockedError`, `RegistryError`, `DocpipeError`.

### `sync(...) -> SyncResult`

```python
def sync(
    directory: str | Path,
    *,
    profile: str | ChunkingProfile = "DEFAULT",
    collection: str = "default",
    persist_dir: str | Path = ".docpipe",
    embed_model: str = "ollama/nomic-embed-text",
    cleaner: str = "default",
    chunker: str = "default",
    embedder: str = "default",
    store: str = "default",
    pii_policy: PiiPolicy | None = None,
    local_only: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> SyncResult
```

Performs three-way reconciliation between `directory` and `<persist_dir>/manifests/<collection>.json` (with pre-chunking `pii_policy` scrubbing/audit logging and `local_only` preflight identical to `ingest`). Both live and `dry_run=True` calls populate `estimated_children`, `estimated_parents`, `estimated_tokens`, and offline `estimated_cost_usd` (`SyncResult.to_dict()`):

1. **Added**: New files on disk are parsed, chunked, embedded (skipped when `dry_run=True`), and inserted into both vector and lexical stores.
2. **Updated**: Modified files (different `sha256`) write new chunks tagged with a new `doc_version`, commit the manifest atomically, and delete stale versions afterward, preventing orphaned clauses if the file shrank.
3. **Skipped**: Files matching manifest hashes (even after `touch`) are skipped (manifest `mtime`/`size` fast-path updates are skipped when `dry_run=True`).
4. **Removed**: Source keys tracked in the manifest that no longer exist under `directory` are purged from ChromaDB, SQLite FTS5, and the manifest. (An empty existing directory cleanly purges all tracked sources.)
5. **`dry_run=True` guarantees**: Performs zero store/manifest/lexical writes, creates no missing `persist_dir`, appends zero `.audit.jsonl` entries on `PiiBlockedError`, and makes zero embedder calls while returning identical delta and offline token/cost estimates.

**Raises**: `UnsupportedFormatError` (if `directory` is not an existing directory or contains an invalid file), `MissingExtraError`, `ModelMismatchError`, `MissingCredentialError`, `PiiBlockedError`, `RegistryError`, `DocpipeError`.

### `reindex(...) -> int | ReindexPreview`

```python
def reindex(
    *,
    embed_model: str,
    collection: str = "default",
    persist_dir: str | Path = ".docpipe",
    embedder: str = "default",
    store: str = "default",
    local_only: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> int | ReindexPreview  # @overload returns int when dry_run=False, ReindexPreview when dry_run=True
```

Migrates an existing collection to a new embedding model (and/or builds its collocated FTS5 lexical index) without re-parsing source files from disk (enforcing `local_only` pre-network when `True`):

1. **Dry-run preview (`dry_run=True`)**: Validates `local_only` and registries (`EMBEDDERS`, `STORES`), returns a zero-work `ReindexPreview` immediately without creating directories if the manifest is missing/empty, reads active committed records via lazy stdlib SQLite `?mode=ro` (`chroma.sqlite3`) when `store == "default"` (`0` bytes written even inside read-only dirs) or via `store_cls` for custom stores, estimates offline tokens and USD cost (`estimate_embedding_cost`), and executes zero embedder calls.
2. **Live execution (`dry_run=False`, default)**: Reads all committed child and parent chunks, embeds all child chunks in memory under the new `embed_model` (if empty, updates `manifest.embed_model`, sets `embed_dim=None`, resets the lexical DB, and returns `0`), rebuilds parent zero-vector placeholders matching `len(new_vectors[0])`, resets ChromaDB + SQLite FTS5, and commits the updated manifest.

- **Returns**: Number of committed child chunks re-embedded (`int`), or `ReindexPreview` (`docpipe_maestro.ingest` / `docpipe_maestro.types`) when `dry_run=True`.
- **Raises**: `MissingCredentialError`, `RegistryError`, `DocpipeError`.

## 2. Phase 2: Online Retrieval, Prompting & Optional Generation

### `retrieve(...) -> list[RetrievedChunk]`

```python
def retrieve(
    question: str,
    *,
    collection: str = "default",
    persist_dir: str | Path = ".docpipe",
    embed_model: str = "ollama/nomic-embed-text",
    top_k: int = 5,
    threshold: float | None = None,
    expand_parent: bool = True,
    follow_crossrefs: bool = True,
    embedder: str = "default",
    store: str = "default",
    searcher: str = "default",
    rerank: bool = False,
    reranker: str = "cross_encoder",
    rerank_top_n: int = 20,
    local_only: bool = False,
    where: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> list[RetrievedChunk]
```

Read-only retrieval enforcing the collection's embedding model lock (and `local_only` pre-network check when `True`):

- Validates `rerank`, `reranker`, and `rerank_top_n` upfront via `validate_rerank_options()` (`rerank_top_n >= 1` integer excluding `bool`, `RERANKERS` resolution and `validate_available()` check when `rerank=True`) and validates `where` upfront via `validate_where()` alongside `EMBEDDERS` / `STORES` / `SEARCHERS` resolution before manifest or early-return checks.
- Evaluates structured metadata filters (`where`):
  - **Chunk attributes**: `source`, `doc_version`, `section`, `clause`, `embed_model` (`str`: shorthand or `$eq`/`$ne`/`$in`/`$nin`), and `page`, `chunk_index` (strict non-`bool` `int`: shorthand or `$eq`/`$ne`/`$in`/`$nin`/`$gt`/`$gte`/`$lt`/`$lte`), plus `$and`/`$or`.
  - **Top-level manifest attributes** (no re-ingestion required): `profile` (case-insensitive scalar/`$eq`/`$ne`/`$in`/`$nin`), `ingested_after`, and `ingested_before` (ISO-8601 UTC inclusive bounds; date-only `YYYY-MM-DD` expands to start/end of day UTC), intersected conjunctively with top-level `source` predicates; empty allowlists short-circuit immediately to `[]` with zero embedding calls.
  - **Validation & §IV Defense-in-Depth**: Rejects unknown keys, reserved `"type"`, nested manifest keys inside `$and`/`$or`, `bool` ints, bad dates, and empty `$in`/`$and` lists via `DocpipeError`; both `ChromaStore.query_children()` (`{"$and": [{"type": "child"}, ...]}`) and `LexicalIndex.search()` enforce matching predicates identically (including absent `page` / `clause` semantics).
- Checks `manifest.embed_model` via `check_model_lock()`; raises `ModelMismatchError` if locked to a different model.
- Resolves `searcher` via `SEARCHERS`:
  - `"default"` (`DenseSearcher`): queries dense child chunks exclusively (`{"type": "child"}` conjunctively combined with normalized `where`) with `include_embeddings=False`, filtering out uncommitted `doc_version` entries (`score` is cosine similarity in `[0.0, 1.0]`).
  - `"fts5_hybrid"` (`Fts5HybridSearcher`): fuses dense vector candidates with filtered read-only SQLite FTS5 BM25 candidates (`candidate_k = max(child_top_k * 2, 20)`) using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (`k = 60`, weights `0.5` / `0.5`), normalized by theoretical maximum `1 / 61` into `[0.0, 1.0]` (dual rank-1 agreement `== 1.0`; single-signal rank-1 `== 0.5`). Short-circuits whitespace/punctuation-only queries (and empty manifest allowlists before checking FTS index existence) to `[]`, and raises `DocpipeError` recommending `reindex` if a non-empty collection lacks an FTS5 index.
- Returns `[]` immediately without calling the embedder if the collection is empty or `top_k <= 0`.
- Applies optional score cutoff `score >= threshold` (`[0.0, 1.0]`) to Stage 1 child scores.
- When `rerank=True`, expands the Stage 1 candidate budget to `max(rerank_top_n, top_k * 3)` when `expand_parent=True` (`max(rerank_top_n, top_k)` otherwise), instantiates the registered `Reranker` (default `"cross_encoder"` -> `CrossEncoderReranker` using `BAAI/bge-reranker-base`, sigmoid-normalized `[0.0, 1.0]` scores, lazy thread-safe `_MODEL_CACHE`), and reranks surviving children **before** parent aggregation (`top_k=len(child_matches)` when expanding parents, `top_k=top_k` otherwise).
- When `expand_parent=True`, searches `top_k * 3` child candidates (or `max(rerank_top_n, top_k * 3)` when reranking), assigns each unique `parent_id` `max(child.score)` across its matched children, resolves the top `top_k` parent sections via `get_by_ids(..., include_embeddings=False)`, and returns up to `top_k` unique parents sorted descending by `score`.
- When `expand_parent=True` and `follow_crossrefs=True`, resolves explicit cross-document section/clause citations (e.g., `Section 4.1 of the Compliance Policy`) in one non-recursive pass when the target section is absent from top-`k` results.
- When `expand_parent=False`, returns matched child chunks sorted descending by `score`.

**Raises**: `ModelMismatchError`, `MissingCredentialError`, `MissingExtraError`, `RegistryError`, `DocpipeError`, `ValueError`.

```python

    question: str,
    sections: Sequence[RetrievedChunk],
) -> str
```

Pure, deterministic function (zero disk I/O, zero network calls) constructing a grounded prompt:

- Separates sections with `---`.
- Instructs the LLM to answer *only* from provided context, preserve conditional exceptions and carve-outs (`unless`, `except`, `subject to`, `provided that`, `until`, emergency overrides), cite source/section (and page only when `Page:` is present in context), and state explicitly when the answer is absent. ```

Lazily loaded (`__getattr__` on `docpipe_maestro`) completion wrappers powered by `litellm.completion` (`answer(..., stream=False)` delegates to `answer_detailed().text`, while `answer(..., stream=True)` returns a pull-based synchronous `Iterator[str]`):

- **Synchronous Pull-Based Streaming (`stream=True`)**: Preflight parameter validation, `model_kwargs` checks, message normalization, `local_only`, and `guard_egress()` PII enforcement execute **eagerly** when `answer(..., stream=True)` is called (inside the active `correlation_id()` scope), while `litellm.completion(..., stream=True)` opens lazily on the first `next()` pull. Closing the iterator early (`.close()` / `GeneratorExit`) closes the underlying stream cleanly and emits `closed_early=True` in the `answer` stage telemetry without raising a truncation or empty-response error.
- **Locality & Egress Guard**: Runs `guard_egress()` across plain string prompts and role-separated message sequences before `has_context` short-circuiting or network requests: `local_only=True` rejects remote models/endpoints before transport I/O, and active `pii_policy` rules scrub or block outbound text for remote providers (`"redact"`/`"block"`/`"allow"` egress modes, honoring per-entity `redact`/`tokenize`/`block` rules).
- **Empty Context Refusal**: Validates inputs and egress rules first, then immediately returns `EMPTY_CONTEXT_REFUSAL` (`"Not found in the provided context."`) — a `GenerationResult` carrying it with zero token telemetry, or a single yielded chunk when `stream=True` — with zero LLM calls when `has_context=False`.
- **Truncation Guard & Telemetry**: `answer_detailed()` captures `finish_reason`, `truncated` (`finish_reason == "length"`), `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `reasoning_tokens`, `total_tokens`, and wall `elapsed_seconds`. Passing `fail_on_truncation=True` raises `DocpipeError` when the provider stops due to token limit (`finish_reason == "length"`) in both buffered and `stream=True` modes.
- **Reasoning-Model Parameter Safety**: `temperature` (`>= 0.0`) and `max_tokens` (`>= 1`) are omitted completely from the LiteLLM request when `None` (while explicit `temperature=0.0` is preserved verbatim). Keeping `max_tokens=None` avoids truncating reasoning models that consume thinking tokens before answering; if you must cap `max_tokens` tightly, pass provider-supported controls via `model_kwargs` (e.g., `model_kwargs={"reasoning_effort": "low"}`). `timeout` defaults to `120.0` seconds.
- **Extra Generation Controls (`model_kwargs`)**: Forwarded to `litellm.completion` (e.g., `top_p`, `frequency_penalty`), excluding reserved/conflicting keys (`model`, `messages`, `prompt`, `api_base`, `base_url`, `api_key`, `temperature`, `max_tokens`, `timeout`, `num_retries`, `stream`) which raise `DocpipeError`.
- **Transport Security (`api_base`)**: Plain `http://` is permitted only for loopback hosts (`localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, `::1`); remote endpoints must use `https://`.
- **Provider Examples**:

```python
from docpipe_maestro import answer, answer_detailed, build_chat_messages, retrieve

sections = retrieve("What is the leave policy?", top_k=5)
messages = build_chat_messages("What is the leave policy?", sections)

# Groq serverless inference (reads GROQ_API_KEY from environment)
groq_reply = answer(
    messages,
    model="groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
    temperature=0.0,
    max_tokens=512,  # Omit (None) or pair with model_kwargs={"reasoning_effort": "low"} for reasoning models
    timeout=30.0,
    has_context=bool(sections),
)

# Detailed result with token telemetry and strict truncation checking
detailed = answer_detailed(
    messages,
    model="together_ai/meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo",
    temperature=0.2,
    model_kwargs={"top_p": 0.9},
    has_context=bool(sections),
    fail_on_truncation=True,
)
print(detailed.text, detailed.total_tokens, detailed.elapsed_seconds)

for chunk in answer(
    prompt,
    model="ollama/qwen2.5:1.5b-instruct",
    has_context=bool(sections),
    stream=True,
):
    print(chunk, end="", flush=True)
print()
```

- **Fail-Fast Resilience & Privacy**: Passes `num_retries=0` so HTTP `429` fails fast with a sanitized `DocpipeError`; HTTP `401`/`403` raise `MissingCredentialError`; empty `choices`, populated `message.refusal` (or delta `refusal`), or `None`/whitespace-only `content` raise `DocpipeError` (specifically diagnosing `max_tokens` exhaustion with `finish_reason='length'` and consumed reasoning output/tokens when thinking tokens exhaust the budget before producing answer text); active env secrets and token patterns are scrubbed from error chains.

**Raises**: `MissingExtraError` (if import fails), `MissingCredentialError`, `PiiBlockedError`, `DocpipeError`.

### Built-In Chunking Profiles

| Constant | `name` | `chunk_size` | `overlap` | `clause_preserving` | `parent_child` | `resolve_crossrefs` | `enrichers` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DEFAULT` | `"DEFAULT"` | `512` | `64` | `False` | `True` | `False` | `()` |
| `POLICY` | `"POLICY"` | `1000` | `80` | `True` | `True` | `True` | `("crossrefs",)` |

You may pass `"DEFAULT"`, `"POLICY"` (case-insensitive string resolved via `resolve_profile`), or construct a custom frozen `ChunkingProfile` instance in Python. Custom profiles omitting `enrichers` (or passing `enrichers=()`) with `resolve_crossrefs=True` automatically normalize `enrichers` to `("crossrefs",)`; passing an explicit non-empty `enrichers` tuple overrides that legacy flag directly:

```python
from docpipe_maestro.types import ChunkingProfile

custom = ChunkingProfile(
    name="STRICT_MANUAL",
    chunk_size=750,
    overlap=50,
    clause_preserving=True,
    parent_child=True,
    resolve_crossrefs=True,
    enrichers=("crossrefs",),
)
ingest("./manual.md", profile=custom, collection="manuals")
```

## 4. Shared Data Models (`docpipe_maestro.types`)

### `ChunkMetadata` (`TypedDict`)

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `Literal["child", "parent"]` | Mandatory filter field in ChromaDB |
| `source` | `str` | Canonical source key (filename or relative POSIX path) |
| `doc_version` | `str` | 12-character `sha256` hex prefix of raw file bytes |
| `section` | `str` | Section heading label (`"Introduction"` fallback if untitled) |
| `clause` | `str \| None` | Clause label (e.g., `"2.1"`, `"Clause 4"`) or `None` |
| `page` | `int \| None` | 1-based page number (PDF) or `None` |
| `chunk_index` | `int` | 0-based position within parent (for children) or section ordinal (for parents) |
| `embed_model` | `str` | `provider/model` used during embedding |

### `Chunk`, `EmbeddedChunk`, `RetrievedChunk`

- `Chunk(id: str, text: str, parent_id: str | None, metadata: ChunkMetadata)`:
  - Validates invariants in `__post_init__`: raises `ValueError` if `"child"` lacks a non-empty `parent_id` or if `"parent"` has `parent_id is not None`.
- `EmbeddedChunk(Chunk)`: adds `vector: list[float]`.
- `RetrievedChunk(EmbeddedChunk)`: adds `score: float` in `[0.0, 1.0]`.

### Generation, Operation & Manifest Records

- `GenerationResult`: `text: str`, `model: str`, `finish_reason: str | None`, `truncated: bool`, `prompt_tokens: int | None`, `completion_tokens: int | None`, `reasoning_tokens: int | None`, `total_tokens: int | None`, `elapsed_seconds: float`
- `IngestResult`: `collection: str`, `embed_model: str`, `ingested: list[str]`, `skipped: list[str]`, `chunks_written: int`, `parents_written: int`
- `SyncResult`: `collection: str`, `embed_model: str`, `added: list[str]`, `updated: list[str]`, `skipped: list[str]`, `removed: list[str]`, `dry_run: bool = False`, `estimated_children: int = 0`, `estimated_parents: int = 0`, `estimated_tokens: int = 0`, `estimated_cost_usd: float | None = None` (supports `.to_dict()`)
- `ReindexPreview` (`docpipe_maestro.ingest`, `docpipe_maestro.types`): `collection: str`, `embed_model: str`, `previous_embed_model: str | None`, `total_sources: int`, `total_children: int`, `total_parents: int`, `estimated_tokens: int`, `estimated_cost_usd: float | None`, `dry_run: bool = True` (supports `.to_dict()`)
- `CollectionStatus`: `collection: str`, `embed_model: str | None`, `embed_dim: int | None`, `total_sources: int`, `total_children: int`, `total_parents: int`, `sources: list[SourceRecord]`
- `SourceRecord`: `source`, `content_hash`, `doc_version`, `size`, `mtime`, `ingested_at`, `embed_model`, `profile`, `chunk_ids`, `parent_ids` (supports `.to_dict()` / `.from_dict()`).
- **Offline Cost & Target Helpers** (`docpipe_maestro.embedder`):
  - `estimate_embedding_cost(embed_model: str, estimated_tokens: int) -> float | None`: returns `0.0` for non-positive token counts or local providers (`ollama/`, `ollama_chat/`, `local/`) without importing `litellm`, else looks up bundled `litellm.model_cost` pricing via `prepare_litellm()` with zero network calls (`None` when unlisted).
  - `is_local_target(model: str, api_base: str | None = None) -> bool` and `enforce_local_only(model: str, api_base: str | None = None, *, operation: str) -> None`: shared loopback/local enforcement helpers
- **PII Types & Privacy Contracts** (`docpipe_maestro.types`, top-level `PiiPolicy`, `PiiBlockedError`, and `register_pii_recognizer`):
  - `PiiAction`: `Literal["redact", "tokenize", "block"]`
  - `EgressAction`: `Literal["redact", "block", "allow"]`
  - `PiiErrorMode`: `Literal["fail", "continue"]`
  - `PiiPolicy`: `TypedDict` with optional `types: dict[str, PiiAction]`, `min_confidence: float`, `languages: list[str]` (default `["en", "es"]`), `on_error: PiiErrorMode`, `egress: EgressAction` (default `"redact"`), `ner: bool`, `token_salt: str`, `token_salt_env: str`
  - `PiiDetection`: `TypedDict` (`entity_type`, `start`, `end`, `score`, `recognizer`) — omits raw matched text
  - `PiiAuditRecord`: `TypedDict` (`timestamp`, `collection`, `source`, `doc_version`, `threshold`, `entity_counts`, `actions`, `blocked`, `mode`) — retained append-only across `remove()` calls
  - `PiiRecognizer`: `@runtime_checkable` `Protocol` (`name`, `entity_type`, `supported_languages`, `detect(text, *, languages)`) in `docpipe_maestro.types` for `@register_pii_recognizer` plugins
  - `audit_log_path(persist_dir: Path, collection: str) -> Path` (`docpipe_maestro.manifest`): validated `<persist_dir>/manifests/<collection>.audit.jsonl` resolver

## 5. Exception Hierarchy & Extension Registries

```text
DocpipeError (Exception)
├── UnsupportedFormatError   # Unknown/legacy binary extension (e.g. .xls/.ppt), missing file/dir, corrupted/ZIP-bomb/non-UTF-8 content
├── MissingExtraError        # Optional dependency missing (pypdf, python-docx, bs4, openpyxl, python-pptx, ebooklib, docutils, sentence-transformers, presidio-analyzer)
├── ModelMismatchError       # Requested embed_model conflicts with manifest.embed_model
├── MissingCredentialError   # Provider rejected missing or invalid API key env var
├── PiiBlockedError          # Configured PII "block" rule or egress="block" matched content
└── RegistryError            # Unregistered stage key or colliding stage registration
```

Nine lazy extension decorators are re-exported from `docpipe_maestro` (`register_parser`, `register_cleaner`, `register_enricher`, `register_chunker`, `register_embedder`, `register_store`, `register_searcher`, `register_reranker`, `register_pii_recognizer`), with custom PII recognizers implementing `docpipe_maestro.types.PiiRecognizer` (`name`, `entity_type`, `supported_languages`, `detect(text, *, languages)`) into the shared `PII_RECOGNIZERS` strategy registry. For Phase 1 post-clean enrichment, built-in `ENRICHERS` keys are `"pii"` (`docpipe_maestro.ingest.enricher.PiiEnricher`) and `"crossrefs"` (`docpipe_maestro.ingest.enricher.CrossrefsEnricher`, active on `POLICY` via `enrichers=("crossrefs",)`). Custom enrichers implement the `Enricher` protocol (`name: str`, `enrich(self, doc: ParsedDocument, ctx: IngestContext) -> ParsedDocument`) via `@register_enricher("<name>")`, receiving `IngestContext` (`collection`, `source`, `content_hash`, `doc_version`, `embed_model`, `profile`, and optional `pii_policy` / `extra`) and executing sequentially in `ChunkingProfile.enrichers` order before chunking. For retrieval, built-in `SEARCHERS` keys are `"default"` (`DenseSearcher`) and `"fts5_hybrid"` (`Fts5HybridSearcher`), and the built-in `RERANKERS` key is `"cross_encoder"` (`docpipe_maestro.query.reranker.CrossEncoderReranker`, loaded lazily and requiring `docpipe-maestro[rerank]`). Custom rerankers follow the `Reranker` protocol (`name: str`, `rerank(self, query: str, chunks: list[RetrievedChunk], *, top_k: int) -> list[RetrievedChunk]`, optionally providing a static/class `validate_available()` method for upfront dependency checks) via `@register_reranker("<name>")`.

Example defensive wrapper for an application backend:

```python
from docpipe_maestro import (
    DocpipeError,
    MissingCredentialError,
    ModelMismatchError,
    UnsupportedFormatError,
    answer,
    build_prompt,
```

- `precision_at_k(retrieved_ids, relevant_ids, k) -> float`: Unique relevant hits in `retrieved_ids[:k]` divided by fixed cutoff `k` (`0.0` if inputs empty).
- `recall_at_k(retrieved_ids, relevant_ids, k) -> float`: Standard IR recall dividing unique top-`k` hits by `len(frozenset(relevant_ids))` (`0.0` if inputs empty).
- `reciprocal_rank(retrieved_ids, relevant_ids) -> float`: `1.0 / rank` for the first relevant ID in `retrieved_ids`, or `0.0`.

Executes `retrieve(..., top_k=max(k_values), rerank=rerank, reranker=reranker, rerank_top_n=rerank_top_n, where=where)` once per query read-only and returns `EvalReport` (`config`, `aggregate`, `per_query`). `EvalConfig` includes `"rerank": True`, `"reranker"`, and `"rerank_top_n"` **only** when `rerank=True` (`total=False` optional fields).

44: ### III. Single Schema Source of Truth
45: 
46: All domain, persistence, and interchange contracts MUST be centralized and strictly typed:
47: 
48: - **Canonical Schema Location:** Every contract (`EvaluationCase`, `ExecutionResult`, `MetricResult`, `RunRecord`, `CalibrationReport`, plus regression/gate payloads) MUST reside in `src/evalforge_maestro/types.py` as Pydantic v2 models carrying an explicit `schema_version` field on persisted and interchange contracts.
49: - **Zero Ad-Hoc Dict Shapes:** Untyped `dict` shapes MUST NOT cross subsystem boundaries, CLI `--json` outputs, judge responses, or `.evalforge/` storage files. Validation errors on schemas or duplicate `EvaluationCase.id` values MUST fail explicitly rather than coercing or overwriting silently.
50: - **Bounded Metric Semantics:** `MetricResult.score` MUST be typed as `float | None` within `[0.0, 1.0]` (never `NaN` or `Inf`), paired with `metric_version` (coupled to formula logic), explicit `status` (`PASS`, `FAIL`, `WARNING`, `INCONCLUSIVE`, `NOT_APPLICABLE`), human-readable `explanation`, supporting evidence references, `anomaly_flags`, and the active metric config snapshot.
51: - **Formal Metric Contracts:** Every metric implementation MUST declare what it measures, required inputs from `EvaluationCase` and `ExecutionResult`, its calculation method, and its known limitations.
52: 
53: ### IV. Evidence-Aware & Anomaly-Safe Evaluation
54: 
55: Evaluation MUST verify intermediate evidence independently of surface answers and prevent aggregate score masking:
56: 
57: - **Decoupled Evidence Inspection:** Retrieval quality, answer quality/groundedness, and agent process execution MUST be evaluated independently from captured `ExecutionResult` artifacts:
58:   - A factually accurate answer backed by irrelevant retrieved chunks MUST pass answer correctness while failing retrieval relevance and/or groundedness.
59:   - Relevant retrieved context paired with an inaccurate or ungrounded answer MUST pass retrieval metrics while failing answer correctness/groundedness.
60:   - Agent tool selection, argument validity, execution order, policy adherence, and token/latency cost MUST be scored independently of final answer text.
61: - **Zero-Divisor & Missing-Reference Safety:** Deterministic IR metrics (`Precision@K`, `Recall@K`, `MRR`, `NDCG@K`, `Hit Rate@K`) and reference-dependent checks MUST return `score = None` with `status = NOT_APPLICABLE` when ground-truth evidence is empty (`|G| == 0`), never dividing by zero or emitting `NaN`.
62: - **Anti-Masking & Anomaly Flags:** Aggregate scores MUST NEVER conceal a failure on any test case marked mandatory (`criteria.mandatory = True`), a severe single-metric or per-case regression, cross-version drift (`dataset_fingerprint`, `metric_version`, or `judge_config_fingerprint` mismatches), or high inter-metric disagreement (such as sub-metric divergence `> 0.3`). Any such condition MUST surface explicit `anomaly_flags` and trigger at minimum `WARNING` (or `FAIL` for mandatory policy/case breaches).
63: - **Judge Injection Isolation & Calibration:** Model-based judges MUST wrap untrusted target outputs and retrieved contexts inside randomized XML/nonce delimiters, validate structured JSON responses strictly via Pydantic schemas (recording unparseable outputs as `INCONCLUSIVE`, never defaulting to `0.0` or `1.0`), and support calibration (`calibrate`) against human labels reporting agreement rate, directional bias (`too_generous` vs. `too_harsh`), mean score delta, and recommended pass threshold.
64: - **Per-Case Fault Isolation:** Single-case or single-metric exceptions or timeouts MUST be captured inside that case's `ExecutionResult` or `MetricResult` (marked error/`INCONCLUSIVE`) without aborting the batch unless `--fail-fast` is enabled.
65: 
66: ### V. Immutable Artifacts & Determinism
67: 
68: Historical evidence and offline gate behavior MUST remain tamper-evident, reproducible, and numerically stable:
69: 
70: - **Immutable Canonical Run Storage:** Persisted `RunRecord` artifacts in `.evalforge/runs/<run_id>.json`, run ledger entries in `.evalforge/manifest.jsonl`, pinned baselines in `.evalforge/baselines.json`, and canonical SHA-256 dataset fingerprints MUST NEVER be mutated in place. Re-runs or dataset modifications MUST generate a new `run_id` and fingerprint.
71: - **Atomic Persistence & Permissions:** In-progress runs MUST checkpoint incrementally to `.evalforge/tmp/<run_id>.jsonl`, and final `.evalforge/runs/<run_id>.json` and `.evalforge/manifest.jsonl` writes MUST commit atomically via temporary file rename (`os.replace`) under `0o700` directory and `0o600` file permissions.
72: - **Canonical Hashing & Numerical Stability:** SHA-256 fingerprints MUST hash canonical JSON (sorted keys, UTF-8 encoding, `\n` LF line endings). Scores and regression deltas MUST round to 6 decimal places with explicit `1e-9` epsilon tolerance to avoid IEEE 754 drift. Built-in deterministic metric formulas MUST be protected by normalized AST/source-hash contract tests so formula edits without bumping `metric_version` fail CI.
73: - **Deterministic Offline `--mock` & `--local-only` Execution:** `--mock` mode MUST run deterministically without API keys or network calls, yielding identical scores, gate determinations, and exit codes across identical runs. `--local-only` MUST block outbound remote endpoints pre-network and enforce air-gap safety (including `LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=true`).
74: - **Deterministic POSIX Exit Codes (`0`–`4`):**
75:   - `0`: `PASS` (or `WARNING` / `INCONCLUSIVE` when `--strict` is disabled).
76:   - `1`: `FAIL` (quality gate threshold violated, mandatory case failed, or `--strict` active on `WARNING`/`INCONCLUSIVE`).
77:   - `2`: Configuration, CLI argument, or dataset/schema validation error.
78:   - `3`: Target adapter or external judge runtime/network failure (when `--fail-fast` is active or zero cases completed).
